About Holink

Holink is a next-generation link-in-bio and creator monetisation platform built for creators, influencers, and small businesses across Southeast Asia. We help users centralise their online presence, manage payments, track performance, and grow their audience — all in one place.

We're looking for a UI/UX Designer (Mid–Senior Level) who can think end-to-end, move fast, and craft delightful experiences that feel simple, modern, and intuitive.

Job Summary

As a UI/UX Designer at Holink, you’ll lead the product experience across web and mobile. You’ll work from research to wireframes, prototypes, user testing, and final UI delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Marketing to design features that are beautiful, functional, and creator-centric.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Product Design & User Experience

Design end-to-end product flows, including onboarding, dashboards, analytics pages, monetisation tools, and payment experiences

Create wireframes, user stories, user flows, high-fidelity mockups, and interactive prototypes.

Conduct usability testing and iterate quickly based on insights and product metrics.

Write clear, concise UX copy when needed.

2. User Research & Data-Driven Design

Conduct interviews, surveys, and behaviour studies with creators, influencers, and small business owners.

Analyse product data (heatmaps, funnels, retention metrics) to identify UX problems.

Translate insights into actionable design improvements that align with business goals.

3. Design System & Visual Consistency

Build and maintain the Holink Design System to ensure consistency across all platforms.

Create reusable UI components and work with frontend engineers for accurate implementation.

Maintain a clean, modern visual style across web and mobile.

4. Cross-functional Collaboration

Work closely with Product Managers to define feature requirements and user journeys.

Collaborate with Engineers to ensure smooth handoffs and proper execution of designs.

Participate in roadmap discussions, contribute ideas, and help shape Holink’s future experiences.

Requirements

Must-Have

• 4–6+ years of experience as a UI/UX Designer for digital products (web or mobile).

• A strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end design work, not just UI visuals.

• Advanced proficiency with Figma (auto-layout, variants, prototyping).

• Deep understanding of UX principles, user psychology, design systems, and usability testing.

• Experience designing both 0→1 features and scaling existing experiences.

• Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions.

• Comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment with rapid iterations.

Nice-to-Have

Experience in creator economy platforms, SaaS products, fintech, or payment flows.

Skills in micro-interactions, UI animations, or motion design.

Basic familiarity with HTML/CSS or component-based systems (React), not required but beneficial.

Experience working with cross-regional teams

Strong visual sense for branding and UI storytelling.

What We Offer

A chance to shape a product from early stage to scale.

A collaborative, fast-moving, experiment-friendly environment.

High ownership and creative freedom in design direction.

Direct impact on thousands of creators and small businesses across Southeast Asia.

Design owns the product interface, the website, and the visual language thathas to make an industrial knowledge graph feel usable rather than intimidating.Two people today, working closely enough with engineering that a design doesnot get thrown over a wall. Our users are maintenance technicians and the supervisors above them. They arewearing gloves, standing near loud machinery, often on a poor connection, andthey have roughly forty seconds of patience before they go back to theWhatsApp group they were already using.

That is the whole design brief. Tap targets are large because hands are gloved.Contrast is high because the light is bad. Flows are short because attention isshort. Everything you design will be judged by whether a technician uses it ona Tuesday afternoon without being told to, not by whether it looks good inaportfolio shot.

You will work across both ends: the field interface technicians touch, and thedashboards their managers read.
What you'll do
• Own features from problem framing through to shipped interface
• Run plant visits and watch real technicians work. This is not optional in this role
• Design for gloves, glare, noise, and intermittent connectivity as first-class constraints
• Build and maintain the design system alongside engineering, in code where useful
• Design the manager-facing dashboards: dense data that stays readable
• Prototype at whatever fidelity answers the question fastest
• Test with real users and change your mind in public when the test says so
What we're looking for
• Three or more years designing software products, with shipped work you can walk us through
• Strong Figma, and comfort building interactive prototypes

Solve Education! is hiring a DevOps / Cloud Engineer to build and own the cloud foundation behind our mission: helping young people everywhere reach their potential through accessible, AI-powered learning. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants their work to keep a global learning platform reliable, secure, and cost-efficient.You’ll design, operate, and improve our cloud environment (primarily AWS, with some GCP) across infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, security, reliability, and cost. You’ll work with a high degree of autonomy and make sound calls without waiting for direction.Our stack: AWS (primary) and GCP · Pulumi/Terraform · GitLab CI · Python/Bash for automation.

Before You ApplyThis role carries real ownership of production systems learners depend on. You’ll handle ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and weigh reliability, security, and cost in your decisions. Some of the near-term work is foundational — tightening how we manage access, credentials, and deployments.

We look for engineers who stay composed under pressure, take full accountability, and hold a high bar without close supervision.If you want a role where infrastructure decisions have visible impact and your work directly supports a mission that matters, we’d love to hear from you.

raw.job_description:
Tech Lead (Senior Full Stack & Mobile)

About SEMA Rewards

SEMA Rewards is a clipping platform live in production in Indonesia. Brands and agencies fund campaigns. Clippers turn the brand's content into short videos, post them on their own accounts across all major social platforms, and get paid real money for the views they bring in. The platform handles everything in between: campaign discovery, submissions, view tracking, reviews, earnings, wallets and payouts.

We're a small team and we ship every day.

The role

This is a lead role reporting directly to the founder. You'll own the whole technical side of the product: the web app, the backend, the Android and iOS apps, our video tools, the infrastructure and the releases. You and the founder decide together what to build next.

We're not looking for someone who waits for instructions. We want someone who talks to clippers and brands regularly, learns where they struggle, and turns that into improvements, week after week.

What you'll do

1. Keep shipping. Build features, fix bugs, and release to staging and production on a steady rhythm.

2. Keep the money right. Wallets, earnings ledgers, payout approvals, campaign funding and payment gateway integrations (payments in, disbursements out, webhook handling) must be correct, auditable and fast.

3. Own the mobile apps. Build our Android and iOS apps in React Native, sharing code with the web app. Handle store submissions and releases on both stores, push notifications and over the air updates.

4. Harden our integrations. Our third party data providers fail often. Retries, timeouts and processing that's safe to replay are daily work here, not edge cases.

5. Stay close to users. Talk to clippers and brands, read support messages and community chats, and watch where people get stuck. Turn that into small releases, then check back on whether the change helped.

6. Simplify our flows. The product grew fast and some paths take too many steps. Start with two: the clipper's path from signup to first payout, and the brand's path from launching a campaign to seeing results.

7. Build our video tools. Give clippers the tools to turn long videos into great short clips.

8. Run production. Own deploys, monitoring and incident response. Watch performance, failed jobs, rate limits, duplicate accounts and fake views. Keep the automated test suite that gates every deploy strong.

9. Measure. Track the funnel so we know where users drop off and whether a change worked.

10. Report daily. At the end of each working day, send the founder a short written update: what shipped, what's next, what's blocked, what you heard from users, and one number that moved.

Your first 90 days

1. Weeks 1 and 2: run the whole stack locally, ship your first fixes, learn how deploys work, and map every user flow.

2. Month 1: own releases, talk to at least 10 clippers and a handful of brands, and deliver a short audit of our flows with the changes you'd make first.

3. Month 3: a shorter path to first payout, a funnel dashboard we trust, a steady feedback loop with users, the mobile apps on a set release schedule, and a first prototype of our video tools.

How we work

1. Nobody hands you a ticket list. You bring proposals backed by what users say and what the data shows, and agree on priorities with the founder.

2. Trunk based development with PRs. Every change is reviewed, gated by CI, and soaks on staging before production.

3. We build with AI coding agents every day. You'll direct them and review their code as strictly as any pull request.

4. You work directly with a non technical founder and decisions happen fast. Honest estimates and specific risk flags matter as much as code.

What you bring

1. 6+ years building production software, including at least 2 years as the lead engineer on a product.

2. Strong TypeScript across the stack. React (ideally NextJS), and clean delivery from designs on web and mobile.

3. Solid backend skills: NodeJS and REST APIs.

4. Real PostgreSQL depth: schema design, safe migrations on a live database, query tuning, connection pooling and its failure modes, lock diagnosis. "Knows SQL" is not this.

5. Financial correctness instincts. You think in transactions, row locks, idempotency and invariants without being asked. You know why a payment webhook must be safe to replay and why a balance check belongs inside the transaction that spends it. You've worked on money flows where a bug costs real money.

6. Production React Native. At least one app shipped to both Google Play and the App Store and maintained after launch. You know app signing, TestFlight, the Play Console and store review. Expo experience preferred.

7. Hands on video experience: processing and transcoding with FFmpeg, and video playback or editing in a web or mobile app.

8. Production operations. You've handled a live outage and know that rollback comes before diagnosis.

9. Defensive integration engineering. You assume external APIs will lie, duplicate or vanish.

10. Initiative and product sense. You find problems yourself by talking to users and reading the data, design a simpler flow, and show with data that it worked.

11. Evidence based communication. You say "I measured X," not "probably Y," and nobody has to chase you for updates.

12. Fluent Bahasa Indonesia and English.

Nice to have

1. Creator economy, social media or marketplace experience

2. Video rendering or editing on the GPU (WebCodecs, WebGL or WebGPU, AVFoundation, MediaCodec)

3. AI video features: automatic captions, highlight detection, reframing to vertical (Python, speech to text, computer vision, LLMs)

4. Running user interviews or usability tests

5. Fraud prevention: duplicate accounts, fake engagement

6. Building for midrange Android phones and slow connections

7. Cloud infrastructure and CI/CD, including GPU workloads

How to apply

Apply through this job post with your CV, your GitHub or portfolio, links to apps you've shipped, and your expected salary range. Add a few sentences about a problem you found yourself by talking to users, before anyone asked you to fix it: how you found it, what you changed, and how you knew it worked.

Our process: a short intro call, a take home exercise, and a final interview with the founder. We'll share our full stack on the first call.

The take home exercise

Two parts: a product review (about 1 hour) and a small app build (about 1 day). Send both within 5 days of the intro call. We'll tell you where to send them on the call.

Part 1: Use our product like a new clipper (about 1 hour)

Go to our website and use it the way a new clipper would: sign up, look around, find a campaign, and get as far toward submitting a clip as you can. Then write up to one page:

1. The three biggest problems you found. For each: what happened, and why it matters to a clipper.

2. How you'd confirm them. What you'd ask real clippers, or which numbers you'd look at, to check that each problem is real and common.

3. What you'd ship first, and why.

We're looking for problems that stop people from earning, not typos.

Part 2: Build a small AI clip app (about 1 day)

Build a small React Native app (Expo is fine) that finds the best moment in a long landscape video and turns it into a short vertical clip:

1. Pick a video from the phone. Any landscape video a few minutes long works.

2. Let AI pick the moment. Use AI to analyze the video and suggest which part is most worth clipping, for example from the transcript, the audio or what's on screen. Show the user why it picked that part.

3. Let the user adjust. The user can accept the suggestion or change the start and end time. The clip must be 60 seconds or less.

4. Make it vertical (9:16). Crop it, fit it on a background, or anything else; your choice.

5. Add one line of caption text, burned into the video.

6. Export it: save it to the phone or open the share sheet.

Use any AI model, API or library you like. The processing can run on the phone, on a small server you write, or both.

Explain your stack. In your README, list the framework, libraries, AI model or API and video tools you used, where each step runs (phone or server), and why you chose them over the alternatives.

AI coding tools are welcome; tell us which parts they wrote and how you checked them.

Send us:

1. A link to the repository, or a zip

2. A README covering how to run it, your stack and why you chose it, your trade offs and what you'd do next, and how you used AI coding tools

3. A 2 to 3 minute screen recording of the app working

Final interview: you'll walk the founder through your code and make one small change to it live, so choose an approach you can explain.

• A CTO whose job is unblocking you and helping you grow

From finance and HR to procurement, customer operations, and IT, our SSC is the backbone that keeps businesses running smoothly.

Job Purposes

The DevOps & AI Analyst is an individual contributor responsible for hands-on engineering of CI/CD pipelines, AI/RPA solutions, Power Platform applications, and integrations across the Non-SAP landscape in Indonesia. The role partners with the Team Lead and other towers to deliver automation and AI initiatives end-to-end.

Key Responsibilities Include

DevOps & CI/CD Engineering:

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions) for custom applications, integrations, and Power Platform solutions.
• Implement Infrastructure-as-Code, secrets management, and environment promotion practices.
• Operate observability for in-scope workloads (logs, metrics, alerts).

AI, RPA & Power Platform Delivery

• Develop and operationalize AI/ML use cases on Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, or Azure ML — including prompt engineering, retrieval, evaluation, and basic guardrails.
• Build and maintain RPA bots and workflow automations (Power Automate, UiPath, or similar).

Integration & App Support

• Develop and support REST/SOAP integrations across SAP, COTS, and custom systems.
• Provide L2/L3 support for in-scope automations and AI workloads; perform RCA and stabilization.

Coordination & Improvement

• Coordinate / oversee Kyndryl and other 3P partners on assigned deliverables; validate code and configuration.
• Mentor junior engineers (where present), promote reusable components, and contribute to runbooks and architecture diagrams.

Job Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
• Minimum 2 years of hands-on application development, DevOps, or automation experience.
• Working knowledge of CI/CD tooling (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions), Git, and Microsoft Azure (App Service, Functions, Key Vault, Storage).
• Hands-on experience in AT LEAST TWO of: AI/ML (Azure OpenAI / Copilot Studio / Azure ML), RPA (Power Automate, UiPath), Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse), API/integration platforms.

If you’re ready to bring your skills to a dynamic environment where your work makes an impact across industries and borders, we’d love to hear from you. Join us at Chandra Asri Group and be part of shaping a smarter, more connected future. Apply today!

PT Lima Titik Satu is a technology company specializing in software and applications development, system integration, and e-learning solutions. About the Role

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to take ownership of our multi-cloud data and reporting infrastructure. You will be the primary infrastructure owner responsible for reliability, security, and continuous improvement.

What You'll Work On

• Manage AWS infrastructure including RDS (PostgreSQL), Lambda, S3, EKS, ECS Fargate, etc

• Maintain and optimize pipeline: Airflow orchestration running on EKS, Athena queries over raw/conformed tables, and downstream PostgreSQL KPI tables

• Support multi-cloud data flows, connecting data sources (PostgreSQL, CSV/log files, Google Play, Google Analytics) into centralized reporting via AWS S3 and GCP BigQuery/Cloud Storage

• Manage CI/CD pipelines for backend services, scheduled reporting jobs, and dashboard deployments (Superset)

• Set up and maintain IAM roles, database access policies, and security best practices across AWS and GCP environments

• Monitor system health, troubleshoot pipeline failures (Lambda, Cron Jobs, Airflow DAGs), and ensure timely resolution of ingestion issues

• Collaborate with Dev and Data teams to provision new environments, replicate infrastructure setups, and support ongoing project migrations.

Requirements

• Minimum 1-2 years of hands-on experience as a DevOps/Cloud/Infrastructure Engineer

• Strong working knowledge of AWS services: EC2/ECS Fargate, Lambda, S3, RDS, IAM, CloudWatch, SES, Athena

• Experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and managing containerized workloads/orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow

• Proficiency with PostgreSQL administration, including access control and query optimization

• Familiarity with GCP services: BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions is a strong plus

• Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or AWS CodePipeline)

• Scripting proficiency in Python and/or Bash for automation tasks

• Solid understanding of cloud security, IAM policy design, and least-privilege access principles

• Experience with BI/reporting tools such as Apache Superset is a plus

• Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced, multi-project environment

• Good communication skills, comfortable coordinating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Nice to Have

• AWS / GCP / DevOps Certification

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or AWS CDK)

• Prior experience handling data pipelines involving sensitive/confidential data with strict access governance

• Experience working in a startup/lean team environment where you own infrastructure end-to-end

Why Join Us

This is a high-ownership role where you'll manage critical infrastructure supporting real business reporting and decision-making across multiple product lines. You'll have the opportunity to shape infrastructure standards, improve existing pipelines, and work closely with both Dev and business stakeholders.

Bandung, Indonesia

• Full-Time

About The Role
We're looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer who is passionate about building impactful solutions that transform education. This role requires strong skills across both front-end and back-end, with the ability to design, build, and scale applications that are reliable, user-friendly, and aligned with our mission.
You'll build end-to-end across our stack, working heavily with AI coding tools (especially Claude Code) — which means you'll direct that work, review it critically, and own the correctness and quality of what ships, front to back. We value adaptability, ownership, and a strong learning attitude.
Our stack:
Next.js + React (TypeScript, Tailwind) on the front end

• Node.js/Express and Python/FastAPI on the back end

• MongoDB + Redis

• Git + CI/CD

• GCP. These are deliberate, AI-friendly choices, so you can move fast and still review with confidence.

Before You Apply
This role is not light, routine, or heavily guided. You'll handle ambiguity, move quickly across multiple priorities, and deliver production-ready solutions with little to no revision — including code an AI agent drafted and you made correct. You must stay calm under pressure, take full responsibility for your work, and deliver reliable outputs even when requirements shift mid-week or feedback needs a fast turnaround.
If you want a role that will stretch your technical range, sharpen your problem-solving, and connect your work to a mission that matters, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

Full-Stack Development

• Design and build front-end and back-end features for web and mobile: responsive, accessible interfaces in Next.js/React, and scalable APIs and services in Node.js/Express and Python/FastAPI.

• Own features end-to-end — data model to UI — with sound design decisions and rigorous testing.

• Work with MongoDB and Redis for reliable, performant data and state.

AI-Assisted Development & Oversight

• Direct Claude Code and other AI tools to build features fast, writing clear specs and prompts.

• Review and refine AI-generated code across the stack; you're accountable for correctness, security, and maintainability — not the AI.

• Set conventions and tests that keep AI output consistent and safe to ship.

Collaboration & Delivery

• Partner with product, design, and program teams to turn requirements into effective solutions.

• Take part in agile ceremonies and code reviews, keep CI/CD deployments fast and safe, and provide prompt support for live systems.

• Maintain clear technical documentation for the systems you build.

What We're Looking For

• 3+ years as a full-stack developer shipping applications in production.

• Front end: proficiency with Next.js/React and TypeScript (Tailwind or similar).

• Back end: strong skills in Node.js/Express and/or Python/FastAPI; comfortable with Next.js server-side code. (Depth on one end plus solid range across the rest is fine — you don't need to be an expert in everything.)

• Experience with MongoDB and Redis, and sound API design.

• Disciplined testing, plus Git and CI/CD.

• Ability to direct AI coding tools (especially Claude Code) and critically review their output — strong enough to catch what the AI gets wrong.

• Strong problem-solving, attention to detail, accountability, and the ability to work independently under pressure.

Bonus Points If You Have

• Containerized deployments (Docker or similar).

• Experience with AI/ML or data-driven applications.

• Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD beyond the basics.

• A real knack for prompt and workflow design with agentic coding tools.

• Experience in edtech, mission-driven, or non-profit projects.

Why Join Us?
You'll be joining a team with a bold mission to transform education. We don't expect perfection, but we do expect creativity, ownership, and a strong learning attitude. If you're looking for routine work, this may not be the right fit. But if you're ready to build end-to-end solutions that matter and create real-world impact — we'd love to hear from you.

About WegoPro

WegoPro is the business travel platform built for modern companies. We help organisations simplify and control corporate travel by bringing together booking, approvals, policy, payments, and reporting into one intelligent platform. As part of the Wego Group, we're combining deep travel expertise with AI-first product development to redefine how businesses travel.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to help build the frontend platform that powers WegoPro. You'll work on a sophisticated, data-rich product used every day by travel managers, finance teams, and business travellers around the world.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role with significant technical ownership. You'll shape our frontend architecture, establish engineering standards, mentor other developers, and build AI-powered experiences that make complex workflows feel intuitive.

What You'll Do

• Own the architecture and evolution of our frontend platform, including our design system, application state, routing, build tooling, and performance.
• Build scalable frontend systems on top of a microservices architecture, designing resilient API integrations, caching strategies, and graceful fallbacks when services fail.
• Develop AI-powered product experiences, including conversational booking, agentic workflows, and streaming interfaces that make AI interactions feel reliable and trustworthy.
• Drive adoption of AI-assisted software development, helping define best practices for using tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex across the engineering team.
• Lead technical design discussions, perform thoughtful code reviews, and mentor engineers to raise the quality of the team's work.
• Take ownership of software quality from development through production, including automated testing, observability, CI/CD, and operational excellence on AWS.
• Partner closely with Product, Design, and Backend Engineering to deliver intuitive, performant user experiences.

What We're Looking For

• Significant experience building modern web applications, with deep expertise developing complex, stateful single-page applications.
• Expert knowledge of Vue 3, including the Composition API, Pinia, Nuxt, and a strong understanding of Vue's reactivity model.
• Strong TypeScript skills and experience with modern frontend tooling, including Vite, code splitting, performance optimisation, and Core Web Vitals.
• Excellent frontend engineering fundamentals, with a passion for building polished, accessible, responsive user interfaces.
• Daily experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex, with sound judgement about where they accelerate development and where they don't.
• Familiarity with modern AI application development, including MCP, agent frameworks, context engineering, evaluation frameworks, and shipping user-facing AI features.
• Practical experience with AWS services including S3, CloudFront, Lambda, ECS, CI/CD pipelines, and feature flagging.
• Strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and a bias for ownership, delivery, and continuous improvement.

Nice to Have

• Experience building products in business travel, fintech, or B2B SaaS.
• Experience with micro-frontend architectures.
• Experience building or maintaining design systems.
• Contributions to open-source projects in the Vue or AI tooling ecosystem.

Why Join WegoPro?

At WegoPro, you'll solve meaningful engineering challenges spanning global travel inventory, multi-currency pricing, enterprise policy engines, and large-scale integrations. You'll join a highly collaborative team where engineers have real ownership, technical decisions have lasting impact, and modern AI tooling is embedded into the way we build software every day.

If you're excited by complex frontend engineering, AI-native product development, and building software that powers business travel at scale, we'd love to hear from you.

raw.job_title: Microsoft Windows Infrastructure Security and Domain Administrator
raw.job_description:
Requirements

Qualifications and Skills

Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• 5+ years of hands-on experience administering enterprise-level Windows Server environments and Active Directory.
• Expert-level knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP.
• Strong experience with Windows security hardening, patch management, and vulnerability remediation.
• Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for automation.
• In-depth experience with virtualization technologies (Hyper-V or VMware).
• Solid understanding of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, VLANs, firewalls, VPN).
• Experience with backup and disaster recovery methodologies and tools.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Strong communication and documentation skills.

Preferred (A Plus)

• Relevant industry certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert (MS-100/101), CompTIA Security+, CISSP).
• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services (Azure AD, Azure VM, Sentinel, Defender suite).
• Experience with identity management and single sign-on (SSO) solutions (e.g., SAML, OAuth, Okta).
• Knowledge of SIEM systems and security monitoring.
• Experience with compliance frameworks (NIST, CIS, ISO 27001).

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Active Directory And Identity Management

• Design, administer, and maintain a complex Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) environment, including domain controllers, forests, domains, and trusts.
• Manage Group Policy Objects (GPOs) for security hardening, software deployment, and user configuration across the enterprise.
• Administer Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) and hybrid identity solutions (Azure AD Connect).
• Implement and manage identity and access management (IAM) solutions, including user provisioning, de-provisioning, and role-based access control (RBAC).
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex AD replication, authentication, and DNS issues.

Windows Server Management

• Install, configure, patch, and maintain Windows Server operating systems (2016, 2019, 2022).
• Manage core infrastructure services including DNS, DHCP, DFS, and File/Print services.
• Implement and manage Hyper-V or VMware virtualization platforms.
• Perform system monitoring, performance tuning, and capacity planning.

Security And Compliance

• Harden Windows servers and Active Directory according to industry benchmarks (e.g., CIS Benchmarks, NIST guidelines).
• Develop and execute a rigorous patch management strategy for all Windows systems.
• Implement and manage endpoint security solutions (Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, CrowdStrike, etc.).
• Configure and manage security tools such as Microsoft Defender for Identity, and Azure Sentinel for threat detection and response.
• Conduct regular security audits, access reviews, and vulnerability assessments.
• Respond to security incidents, participate in investigations, and implement remediation plans.
• Ensure compliance with organizational policies and relevant regulations (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, GDPR).

Automation And Scripting

• Automate repetitive administrative tasks using PowerShell scripting.
• Utilize DevOps principles and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools like Ansible, Terraform, or DSC for configuration management.

Backup, Disaster Recovery, And High Availability

• Design, test, and maintain robust backup and disaster recovery solutions for critical infrastructure.
• Implement high-availability configurations like Failover Clustering.

Collaboration And Support

• Serve as an escalation point for help desk and other IT teams for complex issues.
• Create and maintain detailed system documentation, network diagrams, and operational procedures.
• Collaborate with network, security, and application teams on projects and initiatives.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get To Know Our Team:

The Data department oversees all of Agoda's data-related requirements. Our ultimate goal is to enable and increase the use of data in the company through creative approaches and the implementation of powerful resources such as operational and analytical databases, queue systems, BI tools, and data science technology. We hire the brightest minds from around the world to take on this challenge and equip them with the knowledge and tools that contribute to their personal growth and success while supporting our company's culture of diversity and experimentation. The role the Data team plays at Agoda is critical as business users, product managers, engineers, and many others rely on us to empower their decision making. We are equally dedicated to our customers by improving their search experience with faster results and protecting them from any fraudulent activities. Data is interesting only when you have enough of it, and we have plenty. This is what drives up the challenge as part of the Data department, but also the reward.

The Opportunity:

As a Senior/Staff Data Engineer in CEG (Customer Experience Group), you will help design, build, and maintain the data and software foundations that power how CEG Business users serves customers and agents across all contact channels. You will work closely with Product, Operations, Analytics, Operations Efficiency, WFM, DevOps and engineering teams to deliver reliable data pipelines, scalable models, internal tools, and clear insights that improve customer experience and operational efficiency.

You are comfortable switching between engineering work (pipelines, data models, internal services, tooling, optimization) and analytics work (business questions, dashboards, deep‑dive analysis). You can talk to both engineers and business stakeholders in simple, clear language. At the Staff level, you will also shape CEG's data and tooling strategy, influence cross‑team architecture, and raise the overall engineering and data bar for the team.

What You'll Do:

Data Engineering

• Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and serve data from CEG systems (case management, telephony, chat, bots, QA tools, WFM, CRM) and third‑party tools and logs.
• Develop and optimize data models (e.g., warehouse tables, marts, views) that power CEG reporting, monitoring, forecasting, QA, and experimentation.
• Ensure data quality, reliability, and observability:
• Implement validation checks, anomaly detection, and monitoring for key CEG datasets and metrics.
• Work with stakeholders to define and enforce data definitions, SLAs, and ownership for critical tables and metrics.
• Improve performance and cost efficiency of data jobs and queries (e.g., partitioning, indexing, query tuning, storage format optimization) for high‑volume CEG data (calls, chats, emails, cases, events).
• Collaborate with data platform and engineering teams to standardize tooling and best practices (e.g., version control, CI/CD for data and services, code review, documentation, runbooks).

Data Tools & Product Development

• Design and build data tools and internal products for CEG (e.g., self‑service analytics, case monitoring dashboards, alerting systems, investigator tools, QA/review tools, agent performance views).
• Use languages such as Python, Java, Golang, or JavaScript/TypeScript to implement APIs, data services, and lightweight UIs that expose data in a usable way to agents, managers, and operations teams.
• Work closely with CEG product managers and operations to translate operational pain points into concrete data tools, from problem framing to delivery and iteration.
• Apply solid software engineering practices—testing, code reviews, CI/CD, observability—to data products so they are reliable, maintainable, and easy to extend.
• At Staff level, define and drive the roadmap for key CEG data tools and platforms, ensuring reuse across regions, lines of business, and channels.

Data Analytics & Business Impact

• Partner with CEG product and business teams to translate questions into data problems and design clear analytic approaches.
• Build and maintain dashboards and reports (e.g., contact volumes, handling time, quality, customer outcomes, agent performance, spot alerts) that provide reliable metrics and self‑service access to data.
• Perform deep‑dive analysis to understand trends in contact patterns, customer issues, agent performance, and operational efficiency; identify root causes and propose practical, data‑driven recommendations.
• Define and maintain metrics and KPIs (e.g., CSAT, NPS, SLA, AHT, FCR, quality scores), ensuring consistent definitions across CEG teams and tools.
• Communicate findings in simple, business‑friendly language, including clear implications and recommended next steps.

Stakeholder & Team Collaboration

•
• Act as a trusted data partner for CEG stakeholders (operations leaders, product managers, WFM, QA, training, policy, and regional leadership).
• Work with other data engineers, analysts, and scientists to align on data standards, reusable components, and shared datasets for CEG.
• Mentor junior and mid‑level team members on data engineering, analytics, and software engineering best practices.
• Contribute to continuous improvement of team workflows (code reviews, testing, documentation, runbooks, knowledge sharing, incident reviews).
• At Staff level, influence cross‑team architecture and ways of working, making sure CEG's data ecosystem scales with business growth.

Required Qualifications:

• 8+ years working as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or Data Analyst in a data‑driven environment (Staff level typically 10+ or equivalent scope/impact).
• Strong SQL skills (complex joins, window functions, aggregation, query optimization).
• Experience with at least one major data warehouse / big data technology (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Hive, Spark, Vertica, StarRocks, or similar).
• Solid experience with ETL/ELT tools or orchestration frameworks (e.g., Airflow, dbt, internal frameworks).
• Proficiency in at least one programming language for data and services (e.g., Python, Java, Golang, Kotlin, or JavaScript/TypeScript).
• Experience building production‑grade data pipelines and/or data services with attention to quality, monitoring, and maintainability.
• Experience with BI / visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Superset, Metabase, Looker).
• Strong analytical thinking: comfortable framing business questions, exploring data, and turning results into clear insights.
• Ability to communicate complex topics in simple, concise language to non‑technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with event‑driven data (logs, clickstream, customer journey, contact flows, tracking data).
• Knowledge of data modeling techniques (e.g., dimensional modeling, Kimball, data vault, star/snowflake schema).
• Experience with A/B testing, experimentation platforms, or causal analysis.
• Familiarity with ML pipelines or working with data science teams (e.g., routing models, QA scoring, forecasting, recommendations).
• Experience in online consumer products, travel, e‑commerce, or marketplaces.
• Hands‑on frontend or backend development experience (e.g., building internal tools in React/Next.js, Node.js, or similar frameworks) used by operations or support teams.
• Prior experience in a Staff or Tech‑Lead role, driving technical direction and mentoring multiple engineers/analysts.

raw.job_description:
Join the team building an AI-first company.
Hostinger serves more than 5.5 million clients across 150 countries, but we're still excited about what we're creating next.

AI is changing how we build products, support customers, work together, and solve problems. It helps us move faster, spend less time on repetitive work, and focus on bigger ideas.

If you want your work to influence both what we build and how we build it, we'd like to meet you. Our culture: Guided by 10 company principles .

Your role at Hostinger We're looking for a Linux System Administrator , who will help to build, monitor, maintain, automate, and support our growing global infrastructure, to enable our customers to use the services without a glitch.

You will be working besides other System, Software, and Network engineers. You will dig deep, constantly learn, and gain knowledge to become the next top-level talent.

Curious to learn more? Connect with your hiring manager: Ghiffary Thalib, Infrastructure Monitoring

Your day-to-day

• Watching over one of the largest hosting infrastructures out there - physical and virtual servers, data-center-level networking, and everything in between - and reacting fast when something looks off;

• Owning incidents end to end: response, resolution, clear communication, and post-mortems that actually prevent the next one;

• Building and tuning alerting with Prometheus and Alertmanager, so the signal cuts through the noise;

• Working hands-on with Kubernetes, Ansible, and Terraform to automate and harden the infrastructure you manage;

• Handover with our Infrastructure Monitoring team in Kaunas and Vilnius, so coverage never has gaps.

What will help you succeed

• You have a solid Linux system administration experience with managing physical and virtual servers;

• You have an experience with incident management: response, resolution, communication, and post-mortems;

• You are comfortable troubleshooting data-center-level networking;

• You are proficient with Prometheus and Alertmanager for metrics and alerting;

• You have excellent written communication on complex technical topics;

• You actively ask questions and give and absorb feedback constructively;

• You write things down - the next person on shift depends on it.

Meet your team
You'll be part of our Infrastructure Monitoring team based in Indonesia, working closely with a small, tight-knit group who hand off coverage with our counterparts in Kaunas and Vilnius so nothing falls through the cracks. Day to day, you're in touch with data center technicians, systems and network engineers, and the teams that own the services you're watching - giving you a rare, wide view of how the whole infrastructure fits together.
Benefits you'll love
🚀 360 Growth:
We provide limitless learning opportunities: access to platforms like Reforge and CoachHub, global conferences, feedback culture, digital libraries, and industry-leading subscriptions. Advance your career with internal mobility, and grow with a team eager to share knowledge and support your success.
🎯 Freedom & responsibility:
Work on your terms, whether from the comfort of home or anywhere in the world. With a home office budget, you can elevate your workspace. Enjoy the flexibility to manage your schedule while bringing your ideas to life in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

💪 Wellness simplified:
Your health comes first with company-provided sick days, 20 paid suspension days, Headspace subscriptions, and recharge leave. Participate in wellbeing-dedicated events and simply enjoy the balance of a lifestyle that prioritizes wellness.

🎉 Work hard - play hard:
Celebrate your achievements with company events like Town Hall, Meet the Client initiatives, team-building experiences, and workations. Celebrate life’s big moments with milestone gifts for weddings, new parenthood, and graduations.

Compensation
Salary depending on your experience and skills.

Get ready to take your personal and professional growth to new heights! Join Hostinger today and be part of our journey
🚀

raw.job_description:
As a QC Inspector, you are the eyes and hands of Suitsupply's quality function on the factory floor. Permanently embedded at a production facility, you will perform final random inspections on all active production styles to ensure every garment meets Suitsupply's exacting standards before it leaves the factory. This role is central to our Phase 1 model — one dedicated inspector per factory, building deep knowledge of that facility's processes and quality performance over time. Working closely with factory inspectors and technicians, you will build trusted partnerships that drive continuous quality improvement.

What You Will Do

• Perform final random inspections (FRI, Stage 5) on finished goods in accordance with AQL sampling plans and Suitsupply inspection criteria.
• Evaluate garments against approved PP samples, tech packs, and workmanship standards.
• Classify and document defects accurately (critical, major, minor) with photographic evidence.
• Receive and review factory in-line QC reports for visibility and early risk identification (Stage 4).
• Communicate inspection results to factory management and follow up on corrective actions.
• Submit regular inspection reports to the regional QC Manager.
• Contribute to Stage 7 data collection: accurate defect logging to feed factory scorecards.
• Build strong working relationships with factory production and QC teams.
• Flag systemic quality issues or production risks to the QC Manager promptly.
• Support Phase 2 factory capability development over time.
• Compare AQL results with the factory's own AQL results and identify discrepancies.
• Review AQL and factory performance on a regular basis and assist in improvement plans (e.g. improving rework rates through more technical in-line assistance).
• Assist in bulk fabric inspections and report any issues such as colour shading.

Who You Are

• 2+ years of experience in garment quality inspection, ideally within menswear, tailoring, or shirts.
• Solid knowledge of garment construction, common defect types, and AQL inspection standards.
• Ability to read and interpret tech packs and garment specifications.
• Good written and spoken English for reporting to the regional QC Manager.
• Local language proficiency relevant to factory location.
• Self-motivated, reliable, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
• Sharp and consistent eye for garment quality and workmanship.
• Objective and fair in defect assessment — independent from factory pressure.
• Clear and accurate in documentation and reporting.
• Builds effective working relationships with factory staff while maintaining independence.
• Disciplined, self-directed, and accountable.

What You Will Get

• Autonomy: We empower you to take ownership, make meaningful decisions, and drive impact without layers of sign-off.
• Growth: We see your potential as a key asset. At Suitsupply, you'll have abundant opportunities to learn, grow, and excel in a supportive environment that encourages development at every step.
• Incentivized Bonus: Earn a performance-based bonus tied directly to your productivity and results.
• Corporate Social Responsibility: Our commitment to sustainability and ethical business is unwavering. We work exclusively with suppliers who uphold the highest standards, in alignment with the International Labour Organization.
• Style: Immerse yourself in a world of beautifully crafted, high-quality products, and enjoy a 40% discount on Suitsupply products.

Sebagai QA/QC, kamu akan bertanggung jawab memastikan setiap aplikasi web dan mobile memenuhi kebutuhan bisnis, standar kualitas, dan ekspektasi pengguna sebelum maupun setelah dirilis.

Peran ini bukan hanya tentang menemukan bug. Kamu akan memahami bagaimana sebuah fitur seharusnya bekerja, melakukan pengujian secara sistematis, mengidentifikasi risiko, serta memberikan rekomendasi yang objektif terkait apakah sebuah aplikasi atau fitur sudah layak untuk dirilis.

Kamu juga akan menjadi salah satu quality gate di dalam proses development dengan memastikan setiap issue terdokumentasi dengan jelas, diperbaiki dengan tepat, dan tidak menimbulkan masalah baru setelah deployment.

What You Will Do

• Test Planning & Execution

* Memahami kebutuhan bisnis, user flow, dan acceptance criteria, kemudian menyusun test plan, test scenario, dan test case untuk aplikasi web maupun mobile

* Melakukan berbagai jenis testing seperti functional, regression, exploratory, API, UAT, smoke, dan post-deployment testing secara sistematis berdasarkan risiko dan kebutuhan fitur

• Bug Identification & Validation

* Mengidentifikasi dan mendokumentasikan bug secara terstruktur, termasuk steps to reproduce, evidence, expected result, actual result, severity, dan priority

* Melakukan retest dan regression test untuk memastikan issue telah diperbaiki dengan tepat dan tidak menimbulkan masalah baru

• Release Quality & Monitoring

* Mengevaluasi hasil testing dan memberikan rekomendasi terkait kelayakan aplikasi atau fitur untuk dirilis berdasarkan standar kualitas yang ditentukan

* Melakukan post-deployment checking dan monitoring untuk memastikan aplikasi berjalan dengan baik serta mengidentifikasi potensi issue setelah release

• Collaboration & Quality Improvement

* Berkolaborasi dengan Developer, Project Manager, dan tim terkait dalam mengidentifikasi, menyelesaikan, dan menindaklanjuti issue

* Mendokumentasikan hasil testing dan memberikan insight serta rekomendasi perbaikan untuk meningkatkan kualitas proses development dan mencegah issue berulang

Skills & Experience

• Pendidikan minimal D3 sederajat

• Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 tahun di bidang Quality Assurance / Software Testing

• Memahami Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) dan alur release aplikasi

• Mampu membuat test plan, test scenario, test case, dan bug report secara terstruktur

• Memahami functional, regression, UAT, smoke, exploratory, dan API testing

• Memahami dasar API testing menggunakan Postman atau Insomnia

• Memahami query dasar MySQL atau PostgreSQL untuk melakukan validasi data

• Mampu menggunakan Browser DevTools, termasuk untuk memeriksa Network, Console, dan error aplikasi

• Memahami dasar Git/GitHub

• Berpengalaman menggunakan Playwright, Cypress, atau Selenium menjadi nilai tambah

• Teliti, kritis, sistematis, dan sabar dalam melakukan proses pengecekan

• Berani menyampaikan risiko atau issue ketika kualitas aplikasi belum memenuhi standar

• Memiliki perhatian terhadap user experience, bukan hanya memastikan fitur secara teknis dapat berjalan

Think This Role Is for You?

Kalau kamu tipe orang yang tidak mudah puas hanya karena sebuah fitur terlihat “sudah jalan”, tetapi selalu ingin memastikan apakah sudah benar, aman untuk dirilis, dan benar-benar bekerja sesuai kebutuhan pengguna, role ini mungkin cocok untuk kamu.

Job Category: Engineering Product

Job Type: Full Time

Job Location: Bandung

Job Status: Priority Hiring

Bandung, Indonesia · Full-Time

About the Role

Solve Education! is hiring a Data Engineer to build and own the data infrastructure behind our mission: helping young people everywhere reach their potential through accessible, AI-powered learning. This is a high-ownership role for an engineer who thrives on autonomy, sets a high bar for their own work, and wants their engineering to translate directly into real-world impact.

You’ll design, build, and maintain the data systems that power our global programs — from pipelines to analytics-ready warehouses — covering full-cycle engineering, performance optimization, and governance. You’ll operate with a high degree of independence, make sound decisions without waiting for direction, and ship reliable solutions in a fast-moving environment. This is a role for someone who leads by doing.

Our Stack

We’ve standardized our platform deliberately, and we want someone who’s strong in these tools — not someone we have to retrain on the fundamentals:

• Cloud: Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

• Data warehouse: BigQuery — this is the heart of everything we do, and deep hands-on experience here is required

• Orchestration: Apache Airflow (Cloud Composer)

• Transformation & modeling: dbt (or Dataform)

• Sources: MongoDB (application database) and other operational sources

• BI & visualization: Looker Studio and Metabase

• Languages: Python and SQL

• Streaming (where needed): Pub/Sub

• Version control & delivery: Git, with CI/CD for data workflows

• AI tooling: Claude and other LLM assistants used daily to move faster

Before You Apply

We want to be upfront about how we work. This role moves quickly and trusts you with real ownership. You’ll handle ambiguity, juggle multiple priorities, and deliver production-ready work — sometimes as requirements shift mid-week or feedback needs a fast turnaround. We look for people who stay composed under pressure, take full accountability for their work, and hold themselves to a high standard without close supervision.

If you’re looking for a role that will stretch your technical range, sharpen your problem-solving, and connect your work to a mission that matters, we’d love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

• Design, build, and maintain scalable pipelines in Apache Airflow to ingest data from multiple sources — including MongoDB — into BigQuery.

• Own the data architecture across ingestion, storage, and transformation layers, keeping it reliable, consistent, and high-quality.

• Model raw data into clean, structured, ready-to-consume datasets using dbt/Dataform, including turning event-level data into sessions and other analytical entities.

• Build and curate data sources and data marts that serve analytical and reporting needs across teams.

Performance & Reliability

• Monitor pipeline health, troubleshoot failures, and ensure timely, accurate data delivery with minimal downtime.

• Optimize BigQuery query performance and manage storage/compute cost to keep the platform efficient.

• Implement automated testing, validation, and error handling to keep pipelines robust.

Data Quality & Governance

• Apply best practices in data modeling, security, and compliance, and safeguard data integrity across the platform.

• Implement governance, access controls, and documentation (metric definitions, lineage, business glossary) for secure, consistent data usage.

Analytics & BI Enablement

• Build dashboards and visualizations in Looker Studio and Metabase to support data-driven decisions.

• Partner with stakeholders to define metrics and enable reliable self-service analytics.

AI-Enhanced Workflows

• Use AI-powered tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot, cloud-native AI services) to boost efficiency, scalability, and documentation quality.

• Continuously explore and adopt new technologies that streamline workflows and accelerate delivery.

Collaboration & Documentation

• Work closely with product, engineering, and business teams to define data requirements, metrics, and self-service analytics needs.

• Translate business requirements into efficient, scalable technical solutions, enabling advanced analytics and ML initiatives.

• Maintain technical documentation and standards, track key performance metrics, and propose evidence-based improvements to the platform.

What We’re Looking For

• 2–4 years of experience in data engineering, database development, or related technical roles.

• Strong command of SQL and Python, with solid software-engineering habits.

• Deep, hands-on experience with BigQuery is required — this is non-negotiable, as it’s the core of our platform.

• Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration in Apache Airflow.

• Experience modeling and transforming data with dbt or Dataform.

• Experience building dashboards in Looker Studio and/or Metabase.

• Working knowledge of GCP and experience with both relational and non-relational databases (e.g., MongoDB).

• Tech-savvy, with a habit of learning and applying AI tools in daily work.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities independently and under pressure, with high attention to detail, personal accountability, and strong problem-solving skills.

Bonus Points If You Have

• Real-time data streaming and event-driven architectures (e.g., Pub/Sub, Kafka).

• Experience standing up CI/CD pipelines for data engineering.

• Exposure to MLOps or machine learning pipeline deployment.

• A demonstrated track record of using AI tools (Claude, Copilot, LLM-based assistants, automation frameworks) to accelerate engineering work.

• Experience in mission-driven or non-profit organizations.

Why Join Us?

You’ll be joining a team with a bold mission to transform education. We don’t expect perfection, but we do expect creativity, ownership, and a strong learning attitude. If you’re looking for a conventional engineering role, this may not be the right fit. But if you’re ready to lead with technology, build innovative solutions, and create real-world impact — we’d love to hear from you.

Concorde digitalizes heavy-industry operations, from plant-floor reports to enterprise-grade AI architecture.

Programs & partners
About the team

Design owns the product interface, the website, and the visual language thathas to make an industrial knowledge graph feel usable rather than intimidating.Two people today, working closely enough with engineering that a design doesnot get thrown over a wall. You will often be sitting next to the personbuilding it.
About the role

Our users are maintenance technicians and the supervisors above them. They arewearing gloves, standing near loud machinery, often on a poor connection, andthey have roughly forty seconds of patience before they go back to theWhatsApp group they were already using.

That is the whole design brief. Tap targets are large because hands are gloved.Contrast is high because the light is bad. Flows are short because attention isshort. Everything you design will be judged by whether a technician uses it ona Tuesday afternoon without being told to, not by whether it looks good inaportfolio shot.

You will work across both ends: the field interface technicians touch, and thedashboards their managers read.
What you'll do
• Own features from problem framing through to shipped interface
• Run plant visits and watch real technicians work. This is not optional in this role
• Design for gloves, glare, noise, and intermittent connectivity as first-class constraints
• Build and maintain the design system alongside engineering, in code where useful
• Design the manager-facing dashboards: dense data that stays readable
• Prototype at whatever fidelity answers the question fastest
• Test with real users and change your mind in public when the test says so
What we're looking for
• Three or more years designing software products, with shipped work you can walk us through
• Strong Figma, and comfort building interactive prototypes
• A portfolio that shows your reasoning, not only final screens. We want the wrong turns too
• Genuine interest in operational, data-dense, unglamorous interfaces

About Mobbin

Our mission is to empower the world to design great digital experiences.

Mobbin helps designers and product people find highly-relevant references to their design problems. Today, Mobbin is serving over 3 million users and is used by most design-forward companies such as Wise, Airbnb, Headspace, Duolingo, Uber, and more.

Read more about who we are:

Contract (Full-time), Remote

Note that this is not a UX Designer, UX Researcher, or UX Writer role. You will not be designing or conducting research in any capacity. Instead, you will spend most of your time dissecting apps and taking screenshots.
The role

At Mobbin, we curate thousands of app screenshots every week. Our team of analysts meticulously organizes and tags them by hand, ensuring that our users have access to the most comprehensive references.

As a Content Analyst, you will play a crucial role in ensuring that our library is constantly updated with fresh content for our users.

Each week, you will analyze the best-in-class apps and conduct a detailed breakdown. Your analysis will provide valuable insights to our users, who use it as direct input for their design decisions.
What you'll do...
• Acquire and prepare content on a weekly basis, following our guidelines.
• Conduct a detailed analysis and breakdown of web apps.
• Curate screens and flows following our guidelines on design patterns and UI elements.
• Collaborate with other team members to ensure that all content meets our quality standards.
• Clarify any doubts in your work, for example, by seeking clarification from UX analysts.
• Identify and rectify errors and inconsistencies to maintain high standards.

You should...
• Be meticulous and have strong attention to detail. You should strive to be comprehensive and consistent in your analysis.
• Have a strong interest in UI/UX and a good understanding of design patterns in web design. You will need a firm understanding of UX concepts. You should be highly interested in exploring the smallest details of the apps.
• Be collaborative and communicate effectively. You should have good written and verbal communication skills in English.
• Be self-motivated and work independently. You will need to demonstrate a high degree of stability to get the work done every week.
• Have good time management skills. You will need to be able to coordinate and manage your time effectively to meet the content schedule.
• Have experience working with UI design tools such as Figma and Sketch.

Who are we

TripledotStudios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot's guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We're building a company we're proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we're just getting started.

The role is working within our studio: Ludios

About Ludios

Ludios takes its name from Latin; it means The Game People. Led by Eyal, one of the co-founders of Tripledot Studios, and some of the most experienced people in mobile games, we are a studio that makes and publishes our own casual, free-to-play mobile games. Our team is based across APAC, with the majority of our development happening in Jakarta and Melbourne. We are data-driven, creative, and genuinely passionate about the industry we work in. Right now, we are working on a number of exciting projects, including one built around a globally recognised IP, alongside several original titles we are equally excited about. If crafting games and reaching millions of players is what gets you out of bed, we would love to hear from you.

Role Overview

We're looking for a talented and skilled UX Designer to join our team and help create engaging and intuitive experiences for our next big hit.

As a UX Designer, you will work closely with the Lead UX Designer and the wider game development team to design and improve features throughout the game. You will be responsible for translating feature requirements into clear user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and interaction solutions.

The role will involve working primarily in Figma, creating Lo-Fi wireframes, user flows, flowcharts, and state machines when necessary. You will also research and analyze competitors games to understand existing UX patterns and adapt relevant ideas to our game.

You will join the team at an important stage as we continue to build and evolve our UX team and processes. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to have a meaningful impact on the player experience while developing their skills and taking ownership of features over time.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide engaging, intuitive, and functional UX solutions for new and existing game features.
• Work closely with the Lead UX Designer to understand requirements, identify UX problems, and develop appropriate solutions.
• Translate game and product requirements into clear user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and interaction designs.
• Create Lo-Fi and Mid-Fi wireframes in Figma to quickly explore and communicate UX solutions.
• Create flowcharts and state machines when necessary to communicate complex feature logic, player states, and interactions.
• Break down complex features into clear user journeys, states, interactions, and edge cases.
• Analyze how new features interact with existing game systems and ensure a consistent player experience.
• Research and analyze competitor games to understand how similar features and experiences are designed.
• Identify useful UX patterns from competitor products and adapt them appropriately to our game's needs rather than simply replicating them.
• Iterate on designs based on feedback from the Lead UX Designer, game designers, product team, playtesting, and other stakeholders.
• Design and optimize gameplay and feature flows so that players can easily understand, navigate, and interact with the game.
• Consider different player states, edge cases, and scenarios when designing features.
• Collaborate closely with Game Design, Product, UI, Art, and Engineering teams to ensure UX solutions are practical and technically feasible.
• Maintain organized and understandable UX documentation and Figma files.
• Contribute to improving the team's UX processes, patterns, and best practices.

Required Skills, Knowledge And Expertise

• Professional experience in UX Design within the Games industry, preferably mobile games.
• A portfolio demonstrating completed UX projects and a strong understanding of interaction design.
• Strong understanding of UX fundamentals, user flows, information architecture, and interaction design.
• Ability to break down complex features into clear flows, states, and interactions.
• Good working knowledge of Figma, particularly for wireframing, prototyping, and creating user flows.
• Experience creating Lo-Fi and Mid-Fi wireframes and interactive prototypes.
• Ability to create flowcharts and state diagrams/state machines when required.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to analyze competitor games and identify relevant UX patterns and opportunities.
• Ability to explain and communicate the reasoning behind UX decisions.
• Comfortable receiving feedback and iterating on designs.
• Good understanding of casual game UX and player behavior.
• Good knowledge of and passion for casual/mobile games.

Position: UX Content Analyst (Mobile)
About Mobbin

Our mission is to empower the world to design great digital experiences.

Mobbin helps designers and product people find highly-relevant references to their design problems. Today, Mobbin is serving over 3 million users and is used by most design-forward companies such as Wise, Airbnb, Headspace, Duolingo, Uber, and more.

Read more about who we are:

Contract (Full-time), Remote

Note that this is not a UX Designer, UX Researcher, or UX Writer role. You will not be designing or conducting research in any capacity. Instead, you will spend most of your time dissecting apps and taking screenshots.
The role

At Mobbin, we curate thousands of app screenshots every week. Our team of analysts meticulously organizes and tags them by hand, ensuring that our users have access to the most comprehensive references.

As a Content Analyst, you will play a crucial role in ensuring that our library is constantly updated with fresh content for our users.

Each week, you will analyze the best-in-class apps and conduct a detailed breakdown. Your analysis will provide valuable insights to our users, who use it as direct input for their design decisions.
What you’ll do...
• Acquire and prepare content on a weekly basis, following our guidelines.
• Conduct a detailed analysis and breakdown of mobile apps.
• Curate screens and flows following our guidelines on design patterns and UI elements.
• Collaborate with other team members to ensure that all content meets our quality standards.
• Clarify any doubts in your work, for example, by seeking clarification from UX analysts.
• Identify and rectify errors and inconsistencies to maintain high standards.

You should...
• Be meticulous and have strong attention to detail. You should strive to be comprehensive and consistent in your analysis.
• Have a strong interest in UI/UX and a good understanding of design patterns in mobile design. You will need a firm understanding of UX concepts. You should be highly interested in exploring the smallest details of the apps.
• Be collaborative and communicate effectively. You should have good written and verbal communication skills in English.
• Be self-motivated and work independently. You will need to demonstrate a high degree of stability to get the work done every week.
• Have good time management skills. You will need to be able to coordinate and manage your time effectively to meet the content schedule.
• Have experience working with UI design tools such as Figma and Sketch.

Who We're Looking For:

We are looking for a Backend Developer focused on building high-performance APIs and transaction-processing services for financial systems. The platform is designed to handle hundreds of transactions per second (TPS), requiring low latency, efficient concurrency, reliability, and predictable performance under sustained load.

Minimum Requirements:

• Kotlin + Quarkus: strong backend development experience using reactive architecture.

• JVM & GraalVM: understand JVM mode, Native Image, performance and operational trade-offs.

• RabbitMQ: queues, exchanges, ACK/NACK, QoS/prefetch, DLQ, retry, consumer concurrency and long-lived connections.

• Redis: practical knowledge including Lua scripting, Sorted Sets, TTL, atomic operations and concurrency use cases.

• Databases: MongoDB and MySQL/PostgreSQL; transactions, indexing, locking, query optimization and connection pooling.

• Parallel Processing: practical experience with async processing, multithreading, concurrency, thread pools and race-condition handling.

• Performance: experience designing and optimizing low-latency APIs and services under high concurrent transaction load.

• Observability: experience with Sentry for exception monitoring, tracing and contextual error reporting.

• Reliability: idempotency, retries, timeouts, graceful shutdown, reconnection and failure recovery.

• Location & Availability: Based in or around Bandung, with the ability to attend meetings or work onsite in Bandung occasionally when required.

What We Value:

We want engineers who understand more than CRUD APIs, especially how financial systems behave under high concurrency, sustained load, duplicate messages, race conditions, partial failures and long-running operation. Performance and correctness are equally important.

Nice to Have:

Experience integrating with Cloud HSM (Hardware Security Module), including key management and cryptographic operations.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team The Data department oversees all of Agoda’s data-related requirements. Our ultimate goal is to enable and increase the use of data in the company through creative approaches and the implementation of powerful resources such as operational and analytical databases, queue systems, BI tools, and data science technology. We hire the brightest minds from around the world to take on this challenge and equip them with the knowledge and tools that contribute to their personal growth and success while supporting our company’s culture of diversity and experimentation.

The role the Data team plays at Agoda is critical as business users, product managers, engineers, and many others rely on us to empower their decision making. We are equally dedicated to our customers by improving their search experience with faster results and protecting them from any fraudulent activities. Data is interesting only when you have enough of it, and we have plenty.

This is what drives up the challenge as part of the Data department, but also the reward.

The Opportunity

We are looking for ambitious and agile data scientists that would like to seize the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging productive machine learning and big data platforms worldwide, processing some 600B events every day and making some 5B predictions.

As part of the Data Science and Machine Learning (AI/ML) team you will be exposed to real-world challenges such as: dynamic pricing, predicting customer intents in real time, ranking search results to maximize lifetime value, classifying and deep learning content and personalization signals from unstructured data such as images and text, making personalized recommendations, innovating algorithm-supported promotions and products for supply partners, discovering insights from big data, and innovating the user experience. To tackle these challenges, you will have the opportunity to work on one of the world's largest ML infrastructure employing dozens of GPUs working in parallel, 30K+ CPU cores and 150TB of memory.

• Design, code, experiment and implement models and algorithms to maximize customer experience, supply side value, business outcomes, and infrastructure readiness.

• Research discover and harness new ideas that can make a difference

• Can lead, work independently as well as play a key role in a team.

• Good communication and interpersonal skills for working in a multicultural work environment.

• PhD or MSc in Computer Science / Operations Research / Statistics or other quantitative fields

• Experience in NLP, image processing and/or recommendation systems

• Hands on experience in data engineering, working with big data framework like Spark/Hadoop

• Experience in data science for e-commerce and/or OTA

We welcome both local and international applications for this role. Full visa sponsorship and relocation assistance available for eligible candidates.

Role Description The Frontend UI/UX Designer is a full-time, on-site role based in Bali, Indonesia. This role is responsible for on-site facilities operations, incident and change management, maintenance oversight, technical support, and continuous improvement of critical systems.

You will work closely with internal teams and external service providers to ensure operational excellence, risk control, and high availability across data center facilities.

Responsibilities

• Ensure the safe, stable, and compliant operation of critical facilities systems, including electrical, mechanical, cooling, fire protection, and monitoring systems.

• Lead on-site response to facilities incidents and safety events, including escalation, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and closure.

• Oversee the execution of planned changes, preventive maintenance, and routine inspections, ensuring quality, compliance, and documentation traceability.

• Monitor key operating metrics such as capacity, energy efficiency, and system reliability, and drive improvement opportunities across assigned sites.

• Provide technical support for complex site issues and contribute to engineering reviews, equipment selection, upgrades, and optimization initiatives.

• Coordinate with vendors, colo, and cross-functional teams to support smooth site operations and continuous improvement.

• Strong knowledge of critical infrastructure systems such as power distribution, UPS, generators, HVAC/cooling, fire protection, and BMS/EPMS/DCIM platforms.

• Proven ability to manage incidents, planned works, maintenance activities, and operational risks in a high-availability environment.

• Strong problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills.

• Bilingual or multilingual proficiency is preferred, with proficiency in Chinese considered a strong advantage.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in hyperscale, colocation, or enterprise data center environments.
