raw.job_description:
Tech Lead (Senior Full Stack & Mobile)

About SEMA Rewards

SEMA Rewards is a clipping platform live in production in Indonesia. Brands and agencies fund campaigns. Clippers turn the brand's content into short videos, post them on their own accounts across all major social platforms, and get paid real money for the views they bring in. The platform handles everything in between: campaign discovery, submissions, view tracking, reviews, earnings, wallets and payouts.

We're a small team and we ship every day.

The role

This is a lead role reporting directly to the founder. You'll own the whole technical side of the product: the web app, the backend, the Android and iOS apps, our video tools, the infrastructure and the releases. You and the founder decide together what to build next.

We're not looking for someone who waits for instructions. We want someone who talks to clippers and brands regularly, learns where they struggle, and turns that into improvements, week after week.

What you'll do

1. Keep shipping. Build features, fix bugs, and release to staging and production on a steady rhythm.

2. Keep the money right. Wallets, earnings ledgers, payout approvals, campaign funding and payment gateway integrations (payments in, disbursements out, webhook handling) must be correct, auditable and fast.

3. Own the mobile apps. Build our Android and iOS apps in React Native, sharing code with the web app. Handle store submissions and releases on both stores, push notifications and over the air updates.

4. Harden our integrations. Our third party data providers fail often. Retries, timeouts and processing that's safe to replay are daily work here, not edge cases.

5. Stay close to users. Talk to clippers and brands, read support messages and community chats, and watch where people get stuck. Turn that into small releases, then check back on whether the change helped.

6. Simplify our flows. The product grew fast and some paths take too many steps. Start with two: the clipper's path from signup to first payout, and the brand's path from launching a campaign to seeing results.

7. Build our video tools. Give clippers the tools to turn long videos into great short clips.

8. Run production. Own deploys, monitoring and incident response. Watch performance, failed jobs, rate limits, duplicate accounts and fake views. Keep the automated test suite that gates every deploy strong.

9. Measure. Track the funnel so we know where users drop off and whether a change worked.

10. Report daily. At the end of each working day, send the founder a short written update: what shipped, what's next, what's blocked, what you heard from users, and one number that moved.

Your first 90 days

1. Weeks 1 and 2: run the whole stack locally, ship your first fixes, learn how deploys work, and map every user flow.

2. Month 1: own releases, talk to at least 10 clippers and a handful of brands, and deliver a short audit of our flows with the changes you'd make first.

3. Month 3: a shorter path to first payout, a funnel dashboard we trust, a steady feedback loop with users, the mobile apps on a set release schedule, and a first prototype of our video tools.

How we work

1. Nobody hands you a ticket list. You bring proposals backed by what users say and what the data shows, and agree on priorities with the founder.

2. Trunk based development with PRs. Every change is reviewed, gated by CI, and soaks on staging before production.

3. We build with AI coding agents every day. You'll direct them and review their code as strictly as any pull request.

4. You work directly with a non technical founder and decisions happen fast. Honest estimates and specific risk flags matter as much as code.

What you bring

1. 6+ years building production software, including at least 2 years as the lead engineer on a product.

2. Strong TypeScript across the stack. React (ideally NextJS), and clean delivery from designs on web and mobile.

3. Solid backend skills: NodeJS and REST APIs.

4. Real PostgreSQL depth: schema design, safe migrations on a live database, query tuning, connection pooling and its failure modes, lock diagnosis. "Knows SQL" is not this.

5. Financial correctness instincts. You think in transactions, row locks, idempotency and invariants without being asked. You know why a payment webhook must be safe to replay and why a balance check belongs inside the transaction that spends it. You've worked on money flows where a bug costs real money.

6. Production React Native. At least one app shipped to both Google Play and the App Store and maintained after launch. You know app signing, TestFlight, the Play Console and store review. Expo experience preferred.

7. Hands on video experience: processing and transcoding with FFmpeg, and video playback or editing in a web or mobile app.

8. Production operations. You've handled a live outage and know that rollback comes before diagnosis.

9. Defensive integration engineering. You assume external APIs will lie, duplicate or vanish.

10. Initiative and product sense. You find problems yourself by talking to users and reading the data, design a simpler flow, and show with data that it worked.

11. Evidence based communication. You say "I measured X," not "probably Y," and nobody has to chase you for updates.

12. Fluent Bahasa Indonesia and English.

Nice to have

1. Creator economy, social media or marketplace experience

2. Video rendering or editing on the GPU (WebCodecs, WebGL or WebGPU, AVFoundation, MediaCodec)

3. AI video features: automatic captions, highlight detection, reframing to vertical (Python, speech to text, computer vision, LLMs)

4. Running user interviews or usability tests

5. Fraud prevention: duplicate accounts, fake engagement

6. Building for midrange Android phones and slow connections

7. Cloud infrastructure and CI/CD, including GPU workloads

How to apply

Apply through this job post with your CV, your GitHub or portfolio, links to apps you've shipped, and your expected salary range. Add a few sentences about a problem you found yourself by talking to users, before anyone asked you to fix it: how you found it, what you changed, and how you knew it worked.

Our process: a short intro call, a take home exercise, and a final interview with the founder. We'll share our full stack on the first call.

The take home exercise

Two parts: a product review (about 1 hour) and a small app build (about 1 day). Send both within 5 days of the intro call. We'll tell you where to send them on the call.

Part 1: Use our product like a new clipper (about 1 hour)

Go to our website and use it the way a new clipper would: sign up, look around, find a campaign, and get as far toward submitting a clip as you can. Then write up to one page:

1. The three biggest problems you found. For each: what happened, and why it matters to a clipper.

2. How you'd confirm them. What you'd ask real clippers, or which numbers you'd look at, to check that each problem is real and common.

3. What you'd ship first, and why.

We're looking for problems that stop people from earning, not typos.

Part 2: Build a small AI clip app (about 1 day)

Build a small React Native app (Expo is fine) that finds the best moment in a long landscape video and turns it into a short vertical clip:

1. Pick a video from the phone. Any landscape video a few minutes long works.

2. Let AI pick the moment. Use AI to analyze the video and suggest which part is most worth clipping, for example from the transcript, the audio or what's on screen. Show the user why it picked that part.

3. Let the user adjust. The user can accept the suggestion or change the start and end time. The clip must be 60 seconds or less.

4. Make it vertical (9:16). Crop it, fit it on a background, or anything else; your choice.

5. Add one line of caption text, burned into the video.

6. Export it: save it to the phone or open the share sheet.

Use any AI model, API or library you like. The processing can run on the phone, on a small server you write, or both.

Explain your stack. In your README, list the framework, libraries, AI model or API and video tools you used, where each step runs (phone or server), and why you chose them over the alternatives.

AI coding tools are welcome; tell us which parts they wrote and how you checked them.

Send us:

1. A link to the repository, or a zip

2. A README covering how to run it, your stack and why you chose it, your trade offs and what you'd do next, and how you used AI coding tools

3. A 2 to 3 minute screen recording of the app working

Final interview: you'll walk the founder through your code and make one small change to it live, so choose an approach you can explain.

We are seeking an IoT Engineer to join PT Growth Asia, Rubber Division in a full-time capacity based in Medan, Sumatera Utara. This is a strategic position that sits at the intersection of our engineering and digital transformation initiatives. As an IoT Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing Internet of Things solutions that enhance our operational efficiency, product quality, and decision-making capabilities across our rubber division.
This role is fundamental to our commitment to leveraging advanced technologies to drive innovation and competitive advantage in the rubber industry.

JOB DESCRIPTION / URAIAN PEKERJAAN :

• Act as a technical expert to identify, lead, and integrate new digital technologies across company operations to improve efficiency, reliability, and data-driven decision-making.

• Design, develop, and integrate next-gen IoT systems, focusing on sensor technology and wireless communication in harsh environments.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deploy IoT solutions into all applicable operational and product improvement projects.

• Build and test rugged IoT devices, ensuring the seamless integration of sensors and communication modules.

• Validate performance and quality of IoT systems, and analyze large sensor data sets to refine system accuracy.

• Troubleshoot complex hardware and firmware issues to maintain system uptime and operational integrity.

RESPONSIBILITIES / TANGGUNG JAWAB :

• Develop and optimize firmware / embedded software for microcontrollers and microprocessors utilized in IoT sensors.

• Lead the research, design, and implementation of the IoT system solutions, mainly energy harvesting and data transmission systems.

• Design and implement reliable, low-power wireless communication protocols (e.g. LoRa, Zigbee, proprietary RF) for transmitting data.

• Conduct rigorous bench testing, field trials, and validation of hardware and software prototypes to ensure industrial reliability.

• Configure and manage IoT gateways and edge computing devices to securely collect data from IoT sensors.

• Contribute to the broader digital transformation strategy by identifying and evaluating new IoT opportunities across company.

QUALIFICATIONS / KUALIFIKASI :

• Bachelor or Master in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronics, or a related field.

• Familiarity with industrial data protocols (e.g. Modbus, OPC UA) and experience integrating with cloud IoT platform (AWS, Azure, Google).

• Experience with sensor interface, circuit design (schematics & PCB layout), and system integration for industrial environments.

• Proven expertise in designing and troubleshooting industrial wireless networks, specifically involving LPWAN.

• Experience in embedded C/C++ programming for microcontrollers.

• Experience in Python for data processing & visualization.

• Preferably have experience in Energy Harvesting techniques (e.g. kinetic, vibration-based, or thermal) for self-powered sensors.

• Preferably have experience in predictive maintenance concepts.

• Preferably to have relevant certifications in IoT or cloud technologies.

About us
PT Growth Asia, Rubber Division is a leading player in the rubber manufacturing and processing sector. We are committed to delivering high-quality rubber products whilst embracing technological innovation and sustainable practices. With a focus on operational excellence and continuous improvement, we leverage advanced engineering solutions to meet the evolving needs of our global customers.
Our team is dedicated to fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and professional growth. We invest in our people and provide an environment where talented engineers can thrive, contribute meaningfully to our mission, and build rewarding careers.

Apply now

If you are a talented IoT Engineer eager to make an impact in a dynamic industrial setting, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your CV, a cover letter, and any relevant certifications or portfolio links demonstrating your IoT engineering expertise. Join us in shaping the future of the rubber industry through innovative IoT solutions.

raw.job_description:
Who We're Looking For:

We are looking for a Backend Developer focused on building high-performance APIs and transaction-processing services for financial systems. The platform is designed to handle hundreds of transactions per second (TPS), requiring low latency, efficient concurrency, reliability, and predictable performance under sustained load.

Minimum Requirements:

• Kotlin + Quarkus: strong backend development experience using reactive architecture.

• JVM & GraalVM: understand JVM mode, Native Image, performance and operational trade-offs.

• RabbitMQ: queues, exchanges, ACK/NACK, QoS/prefetch, DLQ, retry, consumer concurrency and long-lived connections.

• Redis: practical knowledge including Lua scripting, Sorted Sets, TTL, atomic operations and concurrency use cases.

• Databases: MongoDB and MySQL/PostgreSQL; transactions, indexing, locking, query optimization and connection pooling.

• Parallel Processing: practical experience with async processing, multithreading, concurrency, thread pools and race-condition handling.

• Performance: experience designing and optimizing low-latency APIs and services under high concurrent transaction load.

• Observability: experience with Sentry for exception monitoring, tracing and contextual error reporting.

• Reliability: idempotency, retries, timeouts, graceful shutdown, reconnection and failure recovery.

• Location & Availability: Based in or around Bandung, with the ability to attend meetings or work onsite in Bandung occasionally when required.

What We Value:

We want engineers who understand more than CRUD APIs, especially how financial systems behave under high concurrency, sustained load, duplicate messages, race conditions, partial failures and long-running operation. Performance and correctness are equally important.

Nice to Have:

Experience integrating with Cloud HSM (Hardware Security Module), including key management and cryptographic operations.

Design Bandung, Indonesia Full time Hybrid Mid to Senior

Concorde digitalizes heavy-industry operations, from plant-floor reports to enterprise-grade AI architecture.

Programs & partners
About the team

Design owns the product interface, the website, and the visual language thathas to make an industrial knowledge graph feel usable rather than intimidating.Two people today, working closely enough with engineering that a design doesnot get thrown over a wall. You will often be sitting next to the personbuilding it.
About the role

Our users are maintenance technicians and the supervisors above them. They arewearing gloves, standing near loud machinery, often on a poor connection, andthey have roughly forty seconds of patience before they go back to theWhatsApp group they were already using.

That is the whole design brief. Tap targets are large because hands are gloved.Contrast is high because the light is bad. Flows are short because attention isshort. Everything you design will be judged by whether a technician uses it ona Tuesday afternoon without being told to, not by whether it looks good inaportfolio shot.

You will work across both ends: the field interface technicians touch, and thedashboards their managers read.
What you'll do
• Own features from problem framing through to shipped interface
• Run plant visits and watch real technicians work. This is not optional in this role
• Design for gloves, glare, noise, and intermittent connectivity as first-class constraints
• Build and maintain the design system alongside engineering, in code where useful
• Design the manager-facing dashboards: dense data that stays readable
• Prototype at whatever fidelity answers the question fastest
• Test with real users and change your mind in public when the test says so
What we're looking for
• Three or more years designing software products, with shipped work you can walk us through
• Strong Figma, and comfort building interactive prototypes

Reimagine access. Reimagine ownership. Build the future with Cinch.

Cinch is Southeast Asia's leading circular tech subscription company, redefining how people and businesses access technology. Instead of adding to the growing e-waste crisis, we enable affordable, sustainable access to devices through subscriptions that maximize reuse and extend their lifecycle.

We operate across B2C, B2B, and B2B2C channels, including major partnerships with global leaders like Samsung. Our model sits at the intersection of powerful mega trends—sustainability, embedded finance, and the shift from ownership to access—creating a massive opportunity to reshape the future of tech consumption.

At Cinch, we are builders with high standards, a bias for action, and a shared mission to create a generational company that outlasts us. Freshly funded by leading institutional investors and growing rapidly, we're creating an environment where ambitious people can do the best work of their careers—and where the work has real, lasting impact.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to lead data-driven decision-making at Cinch. You will analyse complex datasets, identify trends, and turn them into strategic insights that improve business performance.

You will design and implement data models, build dashboards, and partner with cross-functional teams and leadership. The role involves advanced statistical analysis, predictive modelling, and data visualisation using SQL (Python is a strong plus), alongside extensive hands-on experience with BI tools. You should be an expert in dimensional modelling, including fact tables, dimension tables, and star schemas.

This is a team lead and individual contributor role. You will manage a team of data analysts, mentor and coach them, and review their work for correctness and integrity before it reaches the business.

You are also expected to be AI-literate and comfortable working with both Claude Desktop and Claude Code. We expect responsible AI usage, and the correctness of all work submitted remains the analyst's own responsibility.

Responsibilities

Analysis & Insights

• Understand business requirements and plan solutions to meet data needs
• Conduct advanced statistical analysis and predictive modelling to surface trends and opportunities
• Drill down into data and prepare reports with the highest level of accuracy
• Define new KPIs and measure them consistently across datasets
• Own and evolve the company-wide KPI framework across departments, ensuring metric definitions stay consistent and trusted

Data Modelling & Preparation

• Design and maintain dimensional data models (fact tables, dimension tables, star schemas)
• Collect data from multiple sources, then normalise, refine, and prepare it for analytics and visualisation
• Partner with IT and business teams to establish data-driven policies and strategies across the organisation
• Build and maintain data models in SQLMesh, including Jinja-templated SQL macros, following agreed modelling standards

Dashboards & Reporting

• Design, build, test, and publish dashboards and reports on our BI platform (Apache Superset, Looker), and schedule refreshes
• Create wireframes and beta dashboards with a focus on user experience, correctness, and visibility
• Monitor reports and dashboards, and make changes as needed
• Resolve data and performance issues in workbooks and data sources
• Maintain executive-level dashboards that consolidate key metrics across departments for leadership
• Automate recurring report delivery using workflow tools such as n8n

Platform & Governance

• Manage BI platform implementation, architecture, and administration
• Define access controls and implement security measures where required
• Actively manage platform performance and usability
• Improve processes across data management, data collection, dashboard design, and the wider product lifecycle

Team Leadership

• Lead, mentor, and coach a team of data analysts
• Review the team's work for correctness, accuracy, and integrity
• Set standards for analysis quality, documentation, and responsible AI usage

Qualifications

Must-haves

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related discipline (or equivalent experience)
• 6–8 years of experience in data analytics, including at least 2 years leading or mentoring analysts
• Advanced SQL for data manipulation, statistical analysis, and predictive modelling
• Expert knowledge of dimensional modelling (fact tables, dimension tables, star schemas)
• Extensive experience building and managing dashboards and reports in BI tools such as Apache Superset, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or Qlik
• Strong knowledge of data architecture, data mapping, data analysis, and data visualisation
• Ability to manipulate and blend data from multiple sources to design dashboards and visualisations
• Working proficiency with AI tools, including Claude Desktop and Claude Code, and sound judgement on responsible use

Nice-to-haves

• Experience in fintech, e-commerce, or subscription businesses
• Experience with cloud data warehouses and modern data stack tools
• Experience defining data access controls and governance in a BI environment
• Experience with SQLMesh, dbt, or similar data transformation tools
• Experience with workflow automation tools such as n8n
• Strong plus: Python for data manipulation, statistical analysis, predictive modelling, and automation

As a Product Designer Manager, you'll be the creative and strategic force behind products used by traders worldwide. You'll work independently across overlapping time zones, collaborating with product, engineering, and leadership to deliver experiences that are intuitive, fast, and trader-obsessed. As the Product Design Manager at FNmarkets, you will define and drive the product design vision for our trading and brokerage ecosystem, ensuring seamless experiences across client-facing platforms and internal operations. By aligning user needs, business priorities, and regulatory requirements, you will lead cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, high-impact fintech products that strengthen our competitive edge. This is a leadership role with significant managerial capacity, not a pure IC position. You will set the

design vision, manage and mentor a team of product designers, lead and drive performance across your team, and ensure design excellence at every touchpoint. You’ll be responsible for building a high-performing design function that ships world-class trading experiences at scale.

• Conducting and overseeing user research, synthesizing insights from active traders to inform design decisions that move metrics
• Championing user-centered design while balancing business goals, technical constraints, and regulatory requirements
• Prototyping, testing, and iterating rapidly; we value speed and learning over perfection
• Traveling occasionally for co-working sessions, team offsites, user research, and/or strategic planning sessions

What You’ll Need

• A bias for action: you prototype fast, test early, and iterate based on feedback and data (and actually feel comfortable speaking to users to validate early)

• Shape the future of fintech and proprietary trading; your work will empower thousands of traders globally

• Access to cutting-edge tools, resources, and continuous learning opportunities

raw.job_description:
Ready To Build Something Real?

John Galt Services seeks a full-time AI-Native Full-Stack TypeScript Engineer to serve TWO US customers at the same time, splitting your time evenly between them:

• A medical business: a healthcare-technology company that runs a Salesforce-based platform for bariatric surgery programs.

• A hospitality business: a group operating a restaurant, a historic wedding venue, and a planned hotel.

Each customer runs its own dedicated AI platform instance: an assistant that lives in their Slack, reads their email and meetings, and writes and runs software on their behalf. Your job is to make both platforms deliver. You'll connect them to each customer's systems, turn real business pain points into dependable automations, and build the tools each business needs, almost all of it in TypeScript, front end to back end.
You won't be maintaining a legacy codebase nobody cares about. Both are small, founder-led operations with more ideas than engineering hands, and most of what you build will be new. You'll need to switch cleanly between two very different businesses and keep both happy.
You must be fluent in English. You will join our customers' teams as a remote member with real responsibilities, not busywork.

IMPORTANT!

Your application is our first test of your attention to detail and ability to follow instructions. 👀
👉 Read this ENTIRE job listing!
👉 Follow the application instructions EXACTLY!

👉 If you do not meet the minimum qualifications for the job, DO NOT APPLY!

If you fail to follow the instructions below, we will reject your application without reading it!

Minimum Job Qualifications

FLUENT SPOKEN & WRITTEN ENGLISH! You will communicate daily with a US-based team. Your English must be clear and confident, spoken and written. If you aren't sure, keep practicing and apply next time.
REAL SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT EXPERIENCE! We hire experienced developers who haven't yet made the leap to senior. You have years of real development behind you, not just coursework. You are comfortable across the stack: web front end, back-end services, and the API integrations that connect them.
SOLID TYPESCRIPT SKILLS! This is a TypeScript-intensive role, and your interview will dig deep into it. You must understand and value type safety: modelling a domain in types, using generics where they earn their keep, and keeping the compiler on your side. If your instinct is to slap any on everything and "fix it later," this isn't the right fit. You should have built real front-end AND back-end code in TypeScript, including Node.js back-end services.

REAL REACT EXPERIENCE! The front ends you build will be React. You must have shipped real React applications in TypeScript: components, hooks, state management, and talking to a back-end API. A tutorial to-do app does not count.

A PUBLIC GITHUB HISTORY! We will look at your GitHub profile before we look at anything else. Show us what you've built, especially your open-source contributions. If your GitHub is empty, this isn't the right fit.

CURIOSITY ABOUT AGENTIC CODING! You will do much of your work through an AI platform that writes code alongside you. It takes a couple of weeks to get fluent. If you think AI coding tools are a gimmick, or you expect them to do your thinking for you, keep looking.

YOU CAN SERVE TWO MASTERS! You'll be juggling two customers with different businesses, systems, and priorities. You must keep their work and data separate, split your time evenly between them, and switch context without dropping balls.

SELF-DIRECTED OWNERSHIP! You'll work with integrations you've never seen before: Salesforce, Atlassian, Google Workspace, QuickBooks, point-of-sale systems. You won't be expected to know them on day one, but you'll be expected to dig in and figure them out. If you need someone looking over your shoulder at every step, this role will be frustrating for both of us.

A DISCIPLINED ENGINEERING APPROACH! You test what you build. You read the requirements before you code. You document your work. You don't push to main and pray. We don't expect perfection. We DO expect professionalism.

You MUST have at least a Bachelor degree.

You MUST be willing to work late night hours.

You MUST either live on Bali or be willing to relocate to Bali.

You MUST have the right to work legally in Indonesia. JGS does NOT sponsor work visas!

ATTENTION TO DETAIL! The moment we see your application, we'll know.

If you do not meet ALL of these requirements, DO NOT APPLY for this job!

Nice To Have

• Salesforce development (Apex, Lightning, Salesforce APIs). Not required, but this is the experience we want most. The medical customer's product is built on Salesforce, and Salesforce skills will put you at the front of the line.

• AWS platform experience, especially serverless application development (e.g. Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB)

• REST API integrations with third-party SaaS platforms

• Atlassian Jira & Bitbucket, Slack and Google Workspace APIs

• AI coding tools and LLM-based workflows

• Multi-tenant SaaS architecture

• Healthcare data or HIPAA-aware development

• QuickBooks, accounting, or point-of-sale integrations

• Hospitality, restaurant, or inventory systems

What You'll Do

For both customers:

• Platform ownership: Configure and maintain each customer's AI platform instance and keep its integrations healthy.

• Automation engineering: Turn recurring business processes into dependable, scripted jobs, including automated expense monitoring that catches cost anomalies before they add up.

• Documentation: Document what you build so it can be understood and maintained.

For the medical customer:

• Integrate with Slack, Google Workspace, Atlassian, and Salesforce.

• Automate work like document-to-CRM data entry, marketing-content pipelines, and executive briefings.

• Build front-end and back-end tools alongside the customer's existing developer, and help prototype new product ideas.

For the hospitality customer:

• Connect point-of-sale systems through their APIs or through QuickBooks.

• Automate expense tracking and restaurant inventory management.

• Research the customer's existing systems and work out how to integrate them.

Reporting Structure

You report to each customer's owner, who sets day-to-day priorities for their share of your time. You coordinate technical work with each customer's existing technical staff. John Galt Services provides technical direction, architectural guidance, and mentoring.
Working Arrangements

You are supporting our customers remotely, but this is NOT a remote job! We will provide working space and equipment near Canggu, Bali. All work is performed on-site.
Salary & Benefits

New associates start at a probationary pay scale of IDR 8 jt / month gross (i.e. before taxes & benefits). Your probationary period is three months.
After successfully completing probation, you become eligible for placement and performance bonuses that can significantly increase your total compensation:

• Placement Bonus: Up to IDR 4,000,000/month when placed with clients, bringing your effective monthly compensation to IDR 12 jt / month gross.

• Performance Bonus: Up to 50% of your total monthly compensation (base + placement bonus) for any month in which you meet or exceed expectations. This can bring your total pay as high as IDR 18 jt / month gross.

We also reserve a large pool of funds for staff perks, events & annual bonuses. If we are happy with your work, you will be VERY happy with your choice!
Also, our office is just minutes from the beach, right outside Canggu, Bali. If you know, you know!
Growth Path

You are the first engineer on what we expect to become a team. Both customers have more ideas than engineering capacity, and as the work outgrows one person, additional engineers will join. When that happens, you have a clear path to graduate into the team lead role: setting technical direction, mentoring the engineers who join after you, and owning delivery across both customers.
Who Is John Galt?

Good question! Might help to show up at your interview with an answer.
HOW TO APPLY 👈

Make sure your JobStreet profile includes a valid email & WhatsApp phone number.
Include this EXACT cover letter:
It must be written in fluent English, BY YOU, not by an AI assistant. We can tell! 👀

The very top line of the cover letter should contain ONLY a link to your GitHub profile. Nothing else.

Below this, describe your experience as a TypeScript developer: your React front-end work, your back-end work, and any integration or automation work.

If you have ANY Salesforce experience (Apex, Lightning, Salesforce APIs, or administration), tell us about it. What did you build, and on what kind of org? If you have none, say so.

There will be thousands of applicants for this job. Explain why we should pick YOU.

Blibli is on a journey to become Indonesia’s #1 e-commerce platform — built on trust, innovation, and care. We’re creating better experiences for customers, merchants, brands, and sellers through technology, collaboration, and a deep commitment to quality. Here, every idea matters and every action helps us grow stronger together.

As a SRE (Site Reliability Engineer) – Platform Engineer , you'll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable, reliable cloud infrastructure and platform services that support engineering teams in production environments. This role focuses on automation, infrastructure as code, and platform observability to ensure high availability, performance, and operational excellence across the system.

What You'll Work On

• Design, build, and maintain scalable and reliable cloud infrastructure on platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Tencent.
• Manage and operate production environments , ensuring high availability, performance, and security.
• Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, including reusable modules.
• Implement and manage GitOps workflows for infrastructure deployment and lifecycle management.
• Operate and maintain Kubernetes clusters , including networking, ingress, storage, and workload orchestration.
• Troubleshoot and resolve platform and infrastructure issues in production environments.
• Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support efficient and reliable software delivery.
• Automate operational tasks using scripting or programming languages (Go, Python, Bash, etc.).
• Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to ensure platform observability and rapid issue detection.

Qualifications

• Minimum 3+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, SRE, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering roles.
• Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Tencent Cloud.
• Strong understanding of networking, IAM, DNS, load balancing, and cloud security fundamentals .
• Experience building and maintaining reusable Terraform modules .
• Familiarity with GitOps workflows and infrastructure version control practices.
• Hands-on experience operating Kubernetes clusters in production .
• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation processes.
• Proficiency in at least one scripting/programming language ( Go, Python, Bash, etc. )

We believe growth happens when people are empowered to learn, improve, and contribute with confidence. At BES, you’ll work with collaborative teams, supportive leaders, and meaningful challenges that help you grow professionally while supporting a larger transformation journey. This is your opportunity to build expertise, make an impact, and continue growth — transforming together.

raw.job_title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Bandung, Indonesia
raw.job_description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our existing SRE team and build tools and automation that improve production reliability and day-to-day operations. As a senior individual contributor, you will turn initial operational needs into clear requirements, practical system designs, working proofs of concept, and maintainable production solutions.

You will work closely with SRE, Engineering, and Production Support teams, quickly learn our products and support model, and contribute to daily SRE activities. Building new tools and automation is the primary focus of this role, alongside participation in the weekly support rotation.

Location – Hybrid | Bandung, Indonesia (at least 2-3 days per week in the office)

What You’ll be Doing

Tooling and Automation

• Design, build, and maintain internal tools, services, and scripts using Python, Go, and shell scripting to reduce repetitive work and improve operational efficiency.

• Gather and clarify raw requirements from SRE and Engineering teams; define the problem, scope, acceptance criteria, and expected operational outcomes.

• Create system designs covering components, integrations, data flows, security, scalability, and failure handling; explain design choices and trade-offs.

• Build and demonstrate proofs of concept, incorporate feedback, and own delivery through testing, rollout, documentation, and ongoing maintenance.

• Develop and improve CI/CD pipelines for reliable builds, automated testing, deployment, and rollback; automate infrastructure and configuration workflows.

Product Learning and SRE Operations

• Quickly learn product architecture, service dependencies, infrastructure, deployment processes, and the production support model.

• Work alongside the existing SRE team on daily server and service operations, including monitoring, troubleshooting, maintenance, and controlled changes.

• Participate in the weekly rota for SRE operations and on-call support, including out-of-hours incident response when scheduled; follow escalation and handover procedures.

• Investigate production incidents with Engineering and Production Support, contribute to root cause analysis, and turn recurring issues into lasting automation improvements.

Collaboration and Engineering Quality

• Work closely with SRE, Engineering, and Production Support to prioritize operational needs and deliver tools that fit existing workflows.

• Write tested, maintainable code, participate in code and design reviews, and apply secure development practices.

• Maintain system designs, runbooks, operating procedures, and user documentation; demonstrate solutions and support their adoption across teams.

• Improve monitoring, alerting, and service performance, and evaluate delivered automation by its reliability and reduction in manual effort.

About You

• At least 5 years of relevant experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, platform engineering, systems engineering, or production software engineering with operational responsibilities.

• Strong hands-on programming ability in Python or Go, practical shell scripting skills such as Bash, and willingness to work across the team’s languages and tooling.

• Demonstrated experience building and maintaining operational tools or automation beyond one-off scripts, including APIs, error handling, testing, and version control.

• Hands-on experience designing and maintaining CI/CD automation using tools such as Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines, or equivalent platforms.

• Ability to independently clarify incomplete requirements, design a suitable solution, and build a proof of concept that demonstrates its value and feasibility.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure such as AWS or GCP, Linux server administration, networking fundamentals, and troubleshooting production services.

• Experience with infrastructure as code or configuration management, such as Terraform or Ansible, and monitoring and logging platforms such as Datadog, Grafana, or CloudWatch.

• Strong ownership, problem-solving, and written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions to different teams.

• Ability to learn unfamiliar products and support processes quickly, collaborate within an established team, and participate reliably in the weekly operational rota.

• A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Experience

• Docker and Kubernetes, distributed systems, and reliability practices such as service level objectives, capacity planning, and post-incident reviews.

• Cloud backup or SaaS platforms, databases, storage, or messaging systems.

• Building self-service operational tools and integrating cloud APIs, monitoring systems, or ticketing workflows.

About Us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries.

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work.

NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

What You’ll Love

• We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community

• We prioritise your work/life balance offering a hybrid work environment and free in-office lunches throughout the week

• We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement

• Grow personally and together with one of the fastest growing companies globally

• Develop your skills through our renowned training platform

• Receive competitive compensation

• Collaborate with an amazing international workforce

Additional Information

Applicants must hold valid working rights in Indonesia at the time of application. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role.

We are an equal opportunity employer in accordance with Indonesia's Manpower Law. All applicants will receive fair consideration for employment regardless of nationality, gender, age, disability, or background. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace for all employees.

raw.job_description:
The Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team architects, builds, and maintains the rock-solid infrastructure that applications rely on. At the Senior Level, you own reliability, performance, and cost outcomes for the systems under your area end-to-end, not just executing well-defined tasks, but deciding between tradeoffs, scoping ambiguous problems, and driving process and system improvements that span teams. You'll work closely with development, security, and product teams, and mentor other engineers as a technical point of reference for the team.
What You Will Do
• Own the availability, performance, scalability, and security of production systems end-to-end, across cloud (AWS/GCP) and on-premises environments.
• Design and evolve Kubernetes deployment strategy for production workloads.
• Own CI/CD and GitOps pipelines in production (ArgoCD or equivalent) and the Terraform that provisions the infrastructure behind them.
• Diagnose and resolve database performance issues.
• Build and maintain observability that surfaces problems before they become incidents.
• Seek out and implement process and system improvements affecting performance and security, coordinating with multiple stakeholders.
• Scope and lead medium-to-large infrastructure initiatives: gather requirements, prioritize by business impact, and communicate impact to stakeholders.
• Negotiate technical tradeoffs with stakeholders to meet business SLAs.
• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers and junior engineers; promote best practices and standards across the team.
• Maintain documentation and process discipline for the systems and incidents you own.
• Lead structured incident investigation, isolating server, database, and application layers with a metrics-first approach, including on-call during high-traffic events.
What Are We Looking For
• At least 4 years of experience in either SRE, DevOps, MLOps, or platform engineering, including senior-level scope at a high-traffic company.
• Deep expertise in one major cloud provider (preferably AWS), with a proven ability to ramp up on the other quickly.Production experience & expertise withKubernetes &Linux fundamentals
• CI/CD & GitOps (ArgoCD or other equivalent stacks)
• Database performance analysis & monitoring (MySQL, Postgres)
• Observability tooling & standards (Datadog, OpenTelemetry)
• Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
• Strong working English, verbal & written communication. Strong documentation and process discipline.
• On-call & incident handling experience during high-traffic events.
• Comfortable negotiating with stakeholders to propose technical compromises that meet business SLAs.
• Demonstrated growth mindset and proven ability to own ambiguous scope.

Requirements

• Strong proficiency in containerization and orchestration technologies, particularly Docker and Kubernetes
• Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automation, and deployment strategies (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions)

• Hands-on experience with observability and monitoring tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, logging and alerting systems)

Who We Are

Princeton Digital Group (PDG) is a leading developer and operator of AI and cloud hyperscale data centers in Asia Pacific. Headquartered in Singapore, PDG has a presence across high-growth markets in the region including Singapore, Japan, India, Indonesia, China, Malaysia, South Korea, and Australia.

PDG is backed by some of the world’s most reputed blue-chip investors - Warburg Pincus, a leading global private equity firm with a successful history of creating world-class technology, media, and telecommunications (TMT) and real estate platforms; Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan (OTPP), Canada's largest single profession pension plan; Mubadala Investment Company, a sovereign investor that manages a diverse global portfolio for the Government of Abu Dhabi and Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets globally.

Why Join PDG?
• Impact at Scale: Be part of a company that’s enabling digital transformation of economies.
• Career Growth Without Borders: With operations across Asia Pacific and a fast-growing footprint, your next opportunity could be anywhere.
• Culture That Empowers: We foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where every voice is heard and every contribution matters.
• Commitment to Excellence: From governance to workplace safety, we hold ourselves to the highest standards because our people deserve nothing less.

PDG empowers individuals in every role to grow, lead, and leave a lasting impact.

Join us to build the digital future of Asia.

For more information, visit our website www.princetondg.com or follow us on LinkedIn.

We Are Looking For

What we are looking for

We are looking for a Senior Data & Asset Reliability Engineer to drive asset data governance, reliability improvement, capacity planning, and digital infrastructure management within our data center operations. The role is responsible for ensuring data accuracy, asset performance visibility, reporting integrity, and effective decision support across critical facilities.

You will act as the technical focal point for asset management, reliability analytics, and system integration, collaborating closely with Operations, BMS, EPMS, CMMS, ERP, IT, Facilities, vendors, and project teams to maintain a single source of truth for asset and infrastructure data throughout the asset lifecycle.

Your Job Responsibilities
• Develop and Manage the day-to-day operation, administration, and continuous improvement of DCIM, asset management, and reliability data platforms.
• Maintain accurate and auditable records of assets, racks, power, cooling, connectivity, capacity, maintenance history, asset health, and equipment lifecycle information.
• Develop dashboards, alarms, trends, reliability indicators, and performance reports to identify asset risks, operational abnormalities, capacity constraints, and improvement opportunities.
• Own asset naming conventions, data standards, and master data governance.
• Analyse asset performance using reliability metrics such as MTBF, MTTR, Asset Availability, Failure Rate, and Asset Health Index.
• Support capacity planning activities for space, power, cooling, and critical infrastructure to accommodate business growth and operational requirements.
• Support predictive maintenance, root. cause analysis (RCA), failure analysis, and reliability improvement initiatives through operational and maintenance data analytics.
• Troubleshoot data discrepancies, reporting issues, system integration gaps, alarm abnormalities, and asset information inconsistencies.
• Collaborate with BMS, EPMS, CMMS, ERP, IT, Facilities, Operations, vendors, and project teams to support system integration, digitalization initiatives, change management, and issue resolution.
• Ensure data integrity and synchronization across DCIM, BMS, EPMS, CMMS, ERP, ticketing systems, and other business applications.
• Develop and maintain dashboards, KPI reports, asset performance reports, capacity reports, audit reports, and management reports.
• Maintain SOPs, MOPs, EOPs, asset records, configuration records, reliability reports, asset hierarchy, and other operational documentation.
• Review and support asset lifecycle planning, replacement strategies, critical asset assessments, and operational readiness for new deployments, upgrades, and handovers.
• Support Management of Change (MOC), compliance requirements, audits, and governance processes related to asset management and reliability programs.
• As Mentor and giving guidance to engineers on proper asset data management, reporting standards, reliability processes, and digital platform workflows.

Qualities you should have:
• Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Building Services, or a related discipline.
• Minimum 6–8 years of experience in Data Center Operations, DCIM, Asset Management, Reliability Engineering, BMS, EPMS, CMMS, or Critical Facility Infrastructure.
• Strong understanding of data center infrastructure including power systems, UPS, generators, cooling systems, racks, environmental monitoring, connectivity, capacity management, and asset lifecycle management.
• Hands-on experience with DCIM platforms such as Schneider EcoStruxure, Siemens, or equivalent asset and infrastructure management platforms.
• Experience in integrating DCIM with BMS, EPMS, CMMS, ERP, ticketing systems, business intelligence tools, and enterprise reporting platforms.
• Good understanding of Asset Management principles, Reliability Engineering methodologies, and maintenance performance measurement.
• Familiar with reliability concepts and methodologies such as MTBF, MTTR, RCA, FMEA, RCM, Asset Criticality Assessment, and Predictive Maintenance.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, risks, performance gaps, and reliability improvement opportunities.
• Strong Excel, Power BI, dashboard development, and reporting capabilities.
• Familiar with data governance, data quality management, master data management, and digital asset management practices.
• Familiar with control system communication protocols including MODBUS, BACNET, MQTT, OPC, IEC61850, Web API, REST API/KAFKA, and system interoperability frameworks.
• Experience with centralized and integrated business processes involving DCIM, CMMS, ERP, ticketing systems, event management, Management of Change (MOC), and RCA platforms.
• Experience and understanding of SCADA, alarm management systems, infrastructure monitoring systems, and asset performance monitoring.
• Detail-oriented, highly organized, and able to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Able to translate operational and asset data into actionable insights for reliability improvement, capacity planning, and business decision-making.

About the Role Solve Education! is hiring a DevOps / Cloud Engineer to build and own the cloud foundation behind our mission: helping young people everywhere reach their potential through accessible, AI-powered learning. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants their work to keep a global learning platform reliable, secure, and cost-efficient.

You’ll design, operate, and improve our cloud environment (primarily AWS, with some GCP) across infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, security, reliability, and cost. You’ll work with a high degree of autonomy and make sound calls without waiting for direction.

Our stack: AWS (primary) and GCP · Pulumi/Terraform · GitLab CI · Python/Bash for automation.

Before You Apply This role carries real ownership of production systems learners depend on. You’ll handle ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and weigh reliability, security, and cost in your decisions. Some of the near-term work is foundational — tightening how we manage access, credentials, and deployments. We look for engineers who stay composed under pressure, take full accountability, and hold a high bar without close supervision.

If you want a role where infrastructure decisions have visible impact and your work directly supports a mission that matters, we’d love to hear from you.

Responsibilities Infrastructure & IaC

• Design, build, and manage cloud infrastructure on AWS (and GCP where needed) using Pulumi/Terraform.
• Keep infrastructure available, performant, and scalable as the platform grows.
CI/CD & Deployments
• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) for fast, safe, repeatable deployments.
• Manage releases, rollbacks, and deployment safety to minimize disruption.
Security, Reliability & Monitoring
• Apply least-privilege access, sensible network configuration, and good secrets management.
• Run monitoring, logging, and incident response; keep downtime low and detection useful.
• Maintain backups and a workable disaster-recovery plan.
Cost & Collaboration
• Keep cloud spend visible and efficient with budgets and usage controls.
• Work with the Product & Technology team so infrastructure supports what’s being built, and keep documentation and operational standards up to date.

What We’re Looking For • 3 years in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, SRE, or platform engineering.
• Hands-on experience with AWS (and GCP experience a plus).
• Proficiency with Pulumi/Terraform and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI or equivalent).
• Solid cloud-security fundamentals: IAM, least-privilege, networking, and secrets management.
• Experience with monitoring, logging, and incident response.
• Scripting for automation (Python or Bash).
• Pragmatic judgment about reliability vs. cost, with the ability to work independently and own outcomes.

Bonus Points If You Have • Containerized workloads (Cloud Run, ECS) and basic orchestration.
• Experience moving from static credentials to federated identity (Workload Identity Federation, OIDC).
• Exposure to data-platform infrastructure (BigQuery, Airflow).
• A habit of using AI tools to speed up infrastructure and automation work.
• Experience in mission-driven or non-profit organizations.

Why Join Us? You’ll be joining a team with a bold mission to transform education. We don’t expect perfection, but we do expect creativity, ownership, and a strong learning attitude. If you’re looking for a conventional engineering role, this may not be the right fit. But if you’re ready to lead with technology, build solutions that matter, and create real-world impact — we’d love to hear from you.

DevOps / System Administrator Redis (Project Based 6 Bulan)

About the Role

This is a senior, highly technical role at the heart of our Redis infrastructure project. You will be responsible for the architecture, deployment, and operational health of our Redis Enterprise clusters — including live data migration across clusters. You will also be the primary authority on replication topology, CRDB configuration, and cluster-level performance. We expect you to bring both deep Redis Enterprise expertise and the operational discipline of a seasoned infrastructure engineer.

Job Description

• Architect and deploy multi-node Redis Enterprise clusters in server-based environments

• Lead the implementation and upgrade of multiple Redis clusters, including data migration planning and execution

• Design and validate migration strategies using tools provided by Redis

• Configure and manage Active-Passive and CRDB replication topologies across data centres

• Define and enforce cluster configuration standards — eviction policies, persistence, ACLs, etc.

• Lead post-migration data integrity validation and risk assessment

• Mentor the mid/junior Redis Administrator and review their work

• Collaborate with the Technical Lead on migration runbooks and rollback plans

• Serve as the escalation point for cluster-level incidents and performance issues

Requirements :

• 5+ years of experience in infrastructure or platform engineering, with at least 3 years working directly with Redis or Redis Enterprise

• Deep, hands-on knowledge of Redis Enterprise cluster architecture — node roles, shard distribution, replication, and failover

• Proven experience executing or planning Redis cluster migrations or version upgrades in production

• Strong understanding of Redis data structures, persistence mechanisms (RDB/AOF), and eviction policies

• Familiarity with Redis Enterprise REST API for cluster and database management

• Experience with Docker, Docker Compose, or Kubernetes for stateful workload deployment

• Solid scripting skills in Bash or Python for automation and tooling

• Experience with CRDB, Replica Of, or Active-Active replication is strongly preferred

Plus Points;

• You have hands-on experience with Redis Enterprise specifically, not just open-source Redis

• You have planned and executed a rip-and-replace or major version migration of a Redis cluster in a production environment

• You understand the data loss risk profile of different migration strategies and can articulate tradeoffs clearly

• You are comfortable reading and writing against the Redis Enterprise REST API to automate cluster operations

Who we are:

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading data center platform in Asia Pacific, delivering sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure at scale. Headquartered in Singapore and backed by Stonepeak, we operate a rapidly expanding platform with over 30 data centers and 1.8GW of secured IT power across key markets.

Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering the populations they serve. We differentiate through execution – delivering at speed and at scale while combining global standards with deep local expertise. This enables us to provide consistent, sustainable and high-performance infrastructure for hyperscalers and enterprises across the region.

As Asia Pacific’s digital transformation accelerates, Digital Edge is building the infrastructure that powers the next wave of AI and cloud growth. Joining Digital Edge means being part of a high-growth platform at the forefront of AI and cloud infrastructure, where you can make a tangible impact on Asia-Pacific’s digital future.

Our values:

• Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.

• Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.

• Strive: We are driven and determined.

• Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.

• Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

Reporting to the Critical IT Director, this role is the regional owner of Digital Edge’s mission-critical on-premises server infrastructure across our data centre portfolio. This is an estate of more than 100 physical servers, supporting more than 180 critical virtual machines. It unites deep engineering ownership of high-performance server clusters built on the hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI) concept with 24/7 operational excellence. The role owns the physical server hardware and the hypervisor layer that underpin the HCI platform; the operating systems and applications running within the virtual machines are managed by their respective owners and sit outside the scope of this role. The platform is vendor agnostic, and the role demands a deep understanding of the underlying technology stack of compute, virtualisation, software-defined storage and the management planes that bind them. The emphasis is not on deploying the latest and greatest virtualization technology, but on consistency of deployment and a disciplined operational mindset across the portfolio.

Key responsibilities:

• Performance, Optimization & Capacity Engineering

• Own end-to-end performance engineering of high-performance server clusters, establishing baselines and tuning compute, virtualisation and storage layers to eliminate bottlenecks across the stack.

• Lead capacity planning and forecasting for the regional server estate, modelling workload growth and ensuring headroom for expansion without over-provisioning.

• Define and track KPIs for cluster health, utilisation and efficiency, driving continuous optimisation of resource allocation and workload placement.

• Benchmark and evaluate new server hardware generations and HCI software releases, validating price-performance before fleet-wide adoption.

• Infrastructure Strategy & Resilience Architecture

• Own the regional server infrastructure architecture and design standards, built on the hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI) concept while remaining vendor agnostic across hardware and software platforms.

• Design and continually enhance high-availability, clustering, replication, backup and disaster-recovery architectures to meet mission-critical availability targets.

• Develop the multi-year technology roadmap for the server platform, prioritizing consistent, standardized deployments and operational stability over adoption of the newest technology, with predictable lifecycle management and hardware refresh cycles.

• Act as the subject-matter expert (SME) and technical authority for server infrastructure across the regional portfolio, engaging early in data centre design and expansion projects to inform compute deployment decisions.

• 24/7 Operations, Availability & Security

• Run day-to-day operations and maintenance of production server clusters at the hardware and hypervisor layers within a 24/7 operational model, including provisioning, patching, configuration, change, asset and fault management.

• Deploy and operate supporting platform services alongside the core clusters, such as backup infrastructure (e.g. Proxmox Backup Server).

• Serve as the escalation point for major incidents affecting the server estate, providing 24/7 standby on rotation as the last-resort escalation tier, and leading root-cause analysis and driving permanent corrective actions.

• Own security hardening of the server estate, including hypervisor and firmware baselines, vulnerability remediation, access control and audit readiness.

• Ensure comprehensive monitoring, alerting and observability coverage across the fleet, enabling proactive detection of capacity, performance and availability risks.

• Automation, Tooling & Standardization

• Build and maintain infrastructure automation and infrastructure-as-code using tools such as Ansible, Terraform and Python to streamline provisioning, configuration and operations.

• Drive standardisation of server builds, golden images, cluster configurations and operational runbooks across the portfolio.

• Propose and implement system enhancements that improve the performance, reliability and efficiency of the server infrastructure.

• Vendor & Stakeholder Management

• Manage OEM, software and support vendors, including evaluation, coordination and escalation, while preserving the platform’s vendor-agnostic posture.

• Serve as the primary interface for the internal teams whose virtual machines run on the platform, managing onboarding, capacity requests and resource allocation against agreed service levels.

• Communicate proactively with virtual machine owners on planned maintenance windows, platform changes and incidents affecting their workloads, setting clear expectations on service impact and restoration.

• Define and document the shared-responsibility boundary between the platform and virtual machine owners, keeping hypervisor-level and guest-level duties clearly delineated.

Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate:

• Diploma/ Degree in computer science, engineering or equivalent experience

• 5+ years of experience in server and compute infrastructure engineering and operations within mission-critical environments (data centre, colocation, cloud or service provider)

• Deep hands-on expertise with HCI and virtualisation platforms (e.g. Proxmox VE with Ceph, VMware vSphere/vSAN, Nutanix, Hyper-V), including cluster design, high availability and live migration, with a vendor-agnostic mindset and familiarity with supporting services such as Proxmox Backup Server and Proxmox Mail Gateway

• Strong understanding of enterprise server hardware, including firmware lifecycle, out-of-band management (iDRAC, iLO, BMC) and facilities considerations such as power, cooling and rack density

• Experienced in administering Linux at the hypervisor and storage layers at scale, with a strong understanding of Ceph (RBD, CephFS, replication and erasure coding) and data protection (backup, replication, disaster recovery)

• Hands-on experience with automation and infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Ansible, Terraform, Python), and with monitoring, observability and capacity-management tooling

• Ability to participate in a 24/7 rotational standby as the last-resort escalation point, and to support planned maintenance windows

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively with clients, senior management, staff and vendors

Preferred (advantageous):

• Professional certifications, such as VMware VCP/VCAP, Nutanix NCP/NCM, Microsoft (Windows Server / Azure Local) or Red Hat (RHCE) certifications.

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

At Inofarma, we’re on a mission to revolutionize healthcare in Indonesia. Our goal? To build the largest and most innovative pharmacy chain, enhancing the health and well-being of communities across the nation. We deliver accessible, affordable, and high-quality medicines paired with expert pharmaceutical services, while building a brand that Indonesians trust and love.

As we take this ambitious journey toward 1,000 stores, we’re looking for a strategic and analytical Senior Data Analyst – Site Acquisition to turn data into high-impact expansion decisions. This role will be at the forefront of Inofarma’s growth, responsible for analyzing demographic, commercial, customer, competitor, and location data to identify the most promising areas for new stores.

You will play a critical role in developing data-driven site selection models, evaluating location potential, forecasting store performance, and translating complex data into clear recommendations for the Expansion and Operations teams. By combining analytics, market intelligence, and business acumen, you will help Inofarma answer one of the most important questions in our expansion journey: “Where should we open our next store to maximize growth and profitability?”

Key responsibilities

• Data Analysis for Location Selection

• Conduct detailed analyses of demographic, economic, and market data to identify high-potential areas for new store openings.

• Evaluate traffic patterns, population density, income levels, and competitive landscapes to recommend optimal store locations.

• Develop revenue and profitability projections for proposed locations using data models and forecasting tools.

• Market Research

• Research market trends, customer behavior, and industry benchmarks to support the company’s expansion goals.

• Identify potential risks and opportunities in proposed regions based on market and competitor analysis.

• Perform a competitor and pricing analysis.

• Performance Monitoring & Reporting

• Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) for newly opened stores, comparing actual performance against projections.

• Create and maintain post-opening performance reports, highlighting areas of success and potential improvement.

• Provide insights and recommendations for optimizing store performance.

• Support for Strategic Recommendations

• Assist the VP Operations and Expansion Manager in preparing reports and presentations for leadership, summarizing location research and store performance.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to provide data-driven insights that support the company’s expansion strategy.

• Database Management

• Maintain and update a centralized database of market data, competitor analysis, and store performance metrics for ongoing reference.

• Ensure data accuracy and reliability to support future decision-making.

Requirements :

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, Project Management, or a related field

• 2+ years of experience in data analysis, market research, or a related field

• Strong analytical skills and ability to interpret complex datasets

• Strong communication and presentation skills for reporting insights and updates

• Experience in project coordination or supporting operational processes is highly desirable

• Experience in retail or real estate is a plus

• Fluent in English -- both in verbal and written form.

Jika Anda memiliki passion untuk mengoptimalkan strategi trading, menganalisis pasar kripto, dan mengembangkan platform digital, mari bergabung dengan kami!Lokasi: Jakarta Pusat (Kantor Pusat)Jenis Kontrak: Full-Time dengan kemungkinan bonus dan insentif berdasarkan kinerjaGaji: Rp 12.000.000 - Rp 25.000.000 per bulan (tergantung pengalaman dan kinerja)Key Responsibilities:
Menganalisis data pasar kripto untuk mengidentifikasi tren, pola, dan peluang trading yang optimal.

Mengelola portofolio aset kripto dengan tujuan memaksimalkan ROI (Return on Investment) sambil mengelola risiko.

Berkoordinasi dengan tim pengembangan platform untuk mengintegrasikan fitur-fitur analisis data dan trading ke dalam sistem digital kami.

Sarjana (S1) atau setara dalam bidang Matematika, Statistika, Ekonomi, Teknik Komputer, atau bidang terkait.

Kemampuan analisis data yang kuat, termasuk penguasaan Python, R, SQL, atau tools analisis lainnya.
Pemahaman mendalam tentang blockchain, kriptoaset, dan pasar keuangan digital, termasuk mekanisme trading, likuiditas, dan risiko.
Keterampilan dalam menggunakan tools trading seperti TradingView, Binance API, CoinGecko API, atau platform trading lainnya.
Kemampuan komunikasi yang jelas untuk menyampaikan analisis dan strategi kepada tim non-teknis.

Inisiatif dan kemampuan beradaptasi tinggi dalam lingkungan pasar yang dinamis dan berubah-ubah.

Location

Bali, Indonesia.
Type

Full Time, Monday - Friday, 09:00 - 17:00, Saturday, 09:00 - 15:00, 1 hour for lunch.
Welcome to Motel

Our story began during a road trip in the 1990s, where our founders, Will and Andy, travelled across America collecting vintage items while living out of motels. They started purchasing vintage clothing in the USA and selling it wholesale, which eventually led to the creation of stores. From there, they began designing reworked vintage pieces, and thus, Motel was born.
Over 30 years and a team of 200+ people later, every piece of clothing we make is created with the same spirit of fun, freedom and adventure as the road trip that first defined the brand. We’re still ambitious and independent, but now we’re a global team - we work from an operational base in Worcester, a design studio in London and a creative studio in Bali.
The role

To support the efficient, accurate, and smooth running of the business by providing reliable operational administrative support, turning data into clear insight that helps directors make better decisions and managing payments in line with financial control.
Main tasks & responsibilities

Business support

• Provide day-to-day operational support to Regional Director (reports, presentations and briefing materials)

• Coordinate and track projects, deadlines, and deliverables

• Maintain business records, documentation, and process guides

• Help identify and implement process improvements

Data analysis

• Collect, clean, and validate data from multiple sources

• Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports (weekly, monthly, quarterly)

• Analyse trends, variances, and KPIs, and translate findings into clear recommendations

• Run ad hoc analyses to support business questions

Operational and payment administration

• Ensuring correct authorisation before release

• Process other payments in line with approval limits and payment terms

• Support Motel's sustainability initiatives by considering how our practices can improve, actively working in line with the sustainability journey of the business.

About you

Required Skills and Experience

• Proven experience in a business support, analyst, or similar role

• Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, formulas, data modelling)

• Strong attention to detail, especially data and reconciliations

• Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining data to non-technical audiences

• Good organisation and time management across competing priorities

• Discretion with confidential and financial/operational information

• Collaborative, with a service-oriented approach

• Analytical and problem-solving mindset

• Curiosity and appetite for continuous learning

Desirable

• Degree in Business, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

• Experience with an ERP, accounting, or payments platform (e.g. NetSuite, SAP, Xero, Sage)

What's in it for you?

• Competitive salary in line with industry benchmarking

• A comprehensive health and social security package, including working social security.

• Team socials and meetups

• Monthly well-being activities to support your health and wellbeing

• Tailored progression pathways

• Bonus scheme for employees, paid out twice a year at management discretion

• Motel is a growth mentality company!

At Motel Rocks, we value and believe in fostering an inclusive and diverse environment for our employees, customers, and partners. We are committed to building a brand that celebrates differences and promotes equal opportunities.

About Holink

Holink is a next-generation link-in-bio and creator monetisation platform built for creators, influencers, and small businesses across Southeast Asia. We help users centralise their online presence, manage payments, track performance, and grow their audience — all in one place.

We're looking for a UI/UX Designer (Mid–Senior Level) who can think end-to-end, move fast, and craft delightful experiences that feel simple, modern, and intuitive.

Job Summary

As a UI/UX Designer at Holink, you’ll lead the product experience across web and mobile. You’ll work from research to wireframes, prototypes, user testing, and final UI delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Marketing to design features that are beautiful, functional, and creator-centric.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Product Design & User Experience

Design end-to-end product flows, including onboarding, dashboards, analytics pages, monetisation tools, and payment experiences

Create wireframes, user stories, user flows, high-fidelity mockups, and interactive prototypes.

Conduct usability testing and iterate quickly based on insights and product metrics.

Write clear, concise UX copy when needed.

2. User Research & Data-Driven Design

Conduct interviews, surveys, and behaviour studies with creators, influencers, and small business owners.

Analyse product data (heatmaps, funnels, retention metrics) to identify UX problems.

Translate insights into actionable design improvements that align with business goals.

3. Design System & Visual Consistency

Build and maintain the Holink Design System to ensure consistency across all platforms.

Create reusable UI components and work with frontend engineers for accurate implementation.

Maintain a clean, modern visual style across web and mobile.

4. Cross-functional Collaboration

Work closely with Product Managers to define feature requirements and user journeys.

Collaborate with Engineers to ensure smooth handoffs and proper execution of designs.

Participate in roadmap discussions, contribute ideas, and help shape Holink’s future experiences.

Requirements

Must-Have

• 4–6+ years of experience as a UI/UX Designer for digital products (web or mobile).

• A strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end design work, not just UI visuals.

• Advanced proficiency with Figma (auto-layout, variants, prototyping).

• Deep understanding of UX principles, user psychology, design systems, and usability testing.

• Experience designing both 0→1 features and scaling existing experiences.

• Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions.

• Comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment with rapid iterations.

Nice-to-Have

Experience in creator economy platforms, SaaS products, fintech, or payment flows.

Skills in micro-interactions, UI animations, or motion design.

Basic familiarity with HTML/CSS or component-based systems (React), not required but beneficial.

Experience working with cross-regional teams

Strong visual sense for branding and UI storytelling.

What We Offer

A chance to shape a product from early stage to scale.

A collaborative, fast-moving, experiment-friendly environment.

High ownership and creative freedom in design direction.

Direct impact on thousands of creators and small businesses across Southeast Asia.
