• Cloud Computing: SaaS, IaaS, PaaS, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation via scripting (Python/Shell).
• Virtualized Environments: ESX, VMs.
• VPN Gateways: Cisco Firepower, Stormshield, AnyConnect client, The Greenbow client.
• Load Balancers: F5 (LTM, APM), VMware NSX.

Soft Skills:
• You define solutions based on complexity.
• You have the ability to work effectively in an Agile environment, with a results-oriented approach.
• You anticipate, think big, start small, test and learn, fail fast, encourage collective intelligence while remaining value driven.
• You are empathetic and committed to user satisfaction.
• You can work with all levels of personnel within and outside your function and across various entities (e.g., CBU, countries, regions) with international teams.
• You have a strong command of professional English (spoken and written) for effective communication within international teams.
• You possess excellent planning and organizational skills.
• You have a strong ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies and procedures.
• You are autonomous, organized, dynamic, and a driver of change management, fostering teamwork in a fast-paced environment.
• You have strong technical writing skills.
• You are familiar with Thales’ IS/IT organization and passionate about the Group’s IS/IT transformation.
• You have a good understanding of Thales’ context (e.g., key IS/IT stakeholders, matrix organization).
• You are committed to Agile and digital workstyles that enhance collaboration and break down silos.
• You have programming/scripting skills (Python, PowerShell, Bash) for task automation.
• You are familiar with automation principles and orchestration tools like Ansible.

Required Experience:
• Prior experience in configuring network and security infrastructures (Proxies, Sandbox, LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN, Routers, Switches, Firewalls, etc.).
• Hands-on experience with system environments (Windows, Linux, ESX, etc.).
• Previous experience in project management (Waterfall or Agile).
• Knowledge of ITIL processes and ITSM tools.
• Experience in monitoring network performance, troubleshooting, diagnosing, and resolving software, hardware, and other network/system issues.
• Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent, master's degree would be advantage.
• Due to the nature of the work, strong English skills, both written and verbal are required to effectively manage stakeholders.

Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission‑critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. Your Role

As an RoCE / Infiniband Network Engineer, you will provide hands‑on troubleshooting and change execution for high‑speed Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) fabrics. You will work with Remote Direct Memory Access over Converged Ethernet (RoCE) and/or InfiniBand environments, restoring service for common link, switch, Host Channel Adapter (HCA), Network Interface Card (NIC), Remote Direct Memory Access (RDMA), congestion and configuration issues. You will own service restoration and elevate architectural or highly complex fabric conditions to the appropriate Subject Matter Expert (SME).
What You Will Do
• Troubleshoot switch, HCA/NIC, port and optic issues using the Command-Line Interface (CLI), telemetry and fabric-management tools.
• Analyze link errors, drops, flaps, speed and Forward Error Correction (FEC) conditions, congestion counters and RDMA reachability.
• Operate InfiniBand/Unified Fabric Manager (UFM) or NVIDIA Spectrum‑X/RoCE management tooling within approved access boundaries.
• For RoCE environments, troubleshoot Data Center Bridging (DCB), Priority Flow Control (PFC), Explicit Congestion Notification (ECN), Quality of Service (QoS) configuration and common lossless‑network issues.
• For InfiniBand environments, troubleshoot link, subnet and fabric conditions, HCA state and common subnet‑management issues.
• Participate in Border Gateway Protocol (BGP), Ethernet Virtual Private Network (EVPN), leaf‑spine and fabric change implementation as defined by site architecture.
• Correlate network and fabric symptoms with multi‑node GPU/NVIDIA Collective Communications Library (NCCL) workload degradation and engage compute/software teams as needed.
• Perform approved firmware and Operating System (OS) changes, cable/optic replacement and post-change validation.
• Own Service‑Level Agreement (SLA) and ticket progression, contribute to Root Cause Analysis (RCA), mentor Level 1 (L1) engineers and improve operational runbooks.

This role gives you the opportunity to deepen your expertise in high‑speed networking for GPU, AI and High‑Performance Computing (HPC) environments while expanding your capabilities across RDMA, RoCE, InfiniBand, fabric telemetry and automation. As your experience grows, you can progress toward senior network engineering, fabric specialist, architecture or technical leadership roles, supported by continuous learning and hands‑on experience in mission‑critical environments.
Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important, you have a growth mindset and are keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer‑focused, someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless, naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
Required Skills and Experience
• 3-5+ years of data-center network engineering experience, including hands‑on high‑speed fabric experience.
• Production experience with RoCE version 2 (RoCEv2)/RDMA and/or InfiniBand; experience in GPU or HPC environments is strongly preferred.
• Hands‑on experience with switch CLI, optics/cabling, NIC/HCA diagnostics and performance counters.
• Working knowledge of DCB, PFC, ECN, QoS and lossless Ethernet for RoCE environments.
• Working knowledge of UFM and subnet‑management concepts for InfiniBand environments.
• Experience with leaf‑spine, BGP/EVPN and high‑speed 100/200/400 Gigabit (Gb)+ fabrics.
• Formal incident management, change management and RCA experience.
Preferred Skills and Experience
• Experience supporting GPU, AI or HPC infrastructure and correlating network conditions with distributed workload performance.
• Familiarity with NVIDIA Spectrum‑X and/or ConnectX technologies.
• Experience with network telemetry, fabric-management tooling and/or network automation.
